title: B2B Lead Generation & Marketing Automation Specialist
description:
**Part-Time | Remote | 15 Hours per Week**



**Company:** Results & Productivity Management Consulting Inc. (RPMC)



**Compensation:** US$8–10/hour, based on experience, plus performance bonuses for converted leads



**Schedule:** Flexible, with some availability during Eastern Time business hours



**Location:** Remote



About RPMC



Results & Productivity Management Consulting Inc. (RPMC) helps small and medium-sized businesses improve organizational structure, management effectiveness, accountability, and business performance.



Through our consulting services and Executive Briefing peer advisory program, we work with business owners who want to overcome operational challenges, strengthen their management teams, and achieve sustainable growth.



We are looking for an experienced, resourceful, and results-oriented B2B Lead Generation & Marketing Automation Specialist to operate and maintain our existing business development and marketing systems.



This is an execution-focused position. Our marketing tools, CRM infrastructure, and initial campaigns are already established. We need someone who knows how to use these systems effectively, consistently, and independently.



## Primary Objective



Identify and engage qualified business owners, execute personalized outreach campaigns, nurture prospects through our CRM, and generate qualified opportunities that convert into introductory meetings and paying clients.



**We are looking for someone who can produce results, not simply perform marketing activities.**



## Key Responsibilities



### 1. Apollo.io Prospecting & Lead Management



- Identify business owners, CEOs, presidents, and other decision-makers matching our ideal client profile.

- Build and maintain targeted prospect lists using Apollo.io.

- Research prospects and verify contact information.

- Segment prospects by industry, company size, location, and other relevant criteria.

- Maintain accurate records and prevent duplicate contacts.

- Prepare qualified prospects for personalized outreach and CRM enrollment.



### 2. GoHighLevel (GHL) CRM & Marketing Automation



- Manage contacts, tags, pipelines, opportunities, and lead information within GHL.

- Operate existing marketing automation workflows and
 nurture sequences.

- Enroll qualified prospects into the appropriate campaigns.

- Monitor
 replies, engagement, and campaign performance.

- Follow up with interested prospects using approved messaging.

- Ensure leads progress through the appropriate pipeline stages.

- Identify and report workflow errors, unsuccessful campaigns, or opportunities for improvement.



### 3. LinkedIn Sales Navigator & B2B Outreach



- Research and identify qualified prospects using LinkedIn Sales Navigator.

- Prepare personalized connection requests and follow-up messages.

- Support relationship-building activities with business owners and executives.

- Track responses and identify prospects expressing interest.

- Coordinate LinkedIn outreach with GHL and Apollo campaigns.

- Maintain accurate records of conversations and follow-up requirements.



LinkedIn activities must follow platform policies and use authorized methods of access.



### 4. Personalized Marketing & Lead Nurturing



- Use our established prospect personalization process to develop relevant outreach messages.

- Research each prospect's business and identify potential areas of interest.

- Adapt approved messaging to different business-owner audiences.

- Maintain consistent follow-up through
 and other approved channels.

- Identify prospects who demonstrate genuine interest in RPMC's services.

- Coordinate introductory meetings with the company's principal consultant.



### 5. Social Media Management (Preferred)



- Create professional social media graphics using Canva or similar tools.

- Adapt provided marketing content into engaging LinkedIn and
 posts.

- Schedule social media content through GoHighLevel.

- Monitor basic engagement and campaign performance.

- Suggest relevant content ideas based on common business-owner challenges.



### 6. Reporting & Performance Tracking



- Maintain accurate prospecting and lead-generation records.

- Track outreach activity, responses, qualified leads, and conversions.

- Provide a concise weekly production report.

- Identify bottlenecks and opportunities to improve campaign effectiveness.

- Recommend practical improvements to existing marketing processes.



## Required Qualifications



**Candidates must have practical, hands-on experience with all three platforms:**



1. **Apollo.io:** Prospect research, list building, filtering, contact management, and campaign preparation.

2. **GoHighLevel:** CRM management, workflows, pipelines,
 campaigns, and lead nurturing.

3. **LinkedIn Sales Navigator:** B2B prospect research, decision-maker identification, and personalized outreach.



Additional requirements:



- Previous experience in B2B lead generation or marketing automation.

- Excellent written English, particularly for professional communication with business owners and executives.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Ability to manage multiple outreach activities independently.

- Experience working with marketing performance metrics.

- Comfortable using AI tools to support research, personalization, and content development.

- Reliable internet connection and ability to work remotely with minimal supervision.



## Preferred Qualifications



- Experience promoting management consulting, business coaching, professional services, or other B2B offerings.

- Familiarity with Canva and social media content creation.

- Experience integrating Apollo prospecting activities with CRM automation.

- Understanding of
 deliverability, segmentation, and nurture campaigns.

- Experience supporting executive-level outreach.

- Ability to identify and troubleshoot basic workflow or data-management issues.



## Compensation & Performance Incentives



We offer:



- **US$8–10 per hour**, depending on demonstrated experience.

- Approximately **15 hours per week**.

- Flexible remote working arrangements.

- Performance bonuses for qualified prospects who become paying clients.



Proposed bonus opportunities include:



- **US$100** for a converted Executive Briefing membership.

- **US$150–250** for a new consulting client, depending on the engagement value.



Bonuses are subject to documented lead attribution, qualifying criteria, payment collection, and the terms of the agreed compensation plan.



## What Success Looks Like



The successful candidate will:



- Keep a consistent flow of qualified prospects entering our business development process.

- Operate Apollo, GHL, and LinkedIn prospecting activities accurately and consistently.

- Maintain effective, personalized follow-up with prospective clients.

- Generate positive engagement and qualified introductory meetings.

- Keep CRM records and marketing campaigns organized and up to date.

- Work proactively and identify problems before they interrupt production.



We value initiative, accuracy, consistency, and measurable results.



## How to Apply



Please submit:



1. Your résumé or professional profile.

2. A brief description of your hands-on experience with Apollo.io, GoHighLevel, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator.

3. An example of a B2B prospecting or lead-nurturing campaign you have personally managed, including measurable results where available.

4. Your requested hourly rate in USD.

5. Your availability and working time zone.



**Shortlisted applicants will be asked to complete a short, paid practical skills assessment** demonstrating prospect research, CRM organization, and personalized outreach.



We are looking for a dependable long-term team member who can take ownership of our marketing execution and contribute directly to RPMC's growth.

title: Online Reputation Management (ORM) & Community Specialist – SEO / Forums | Part-Time, Remote
description:
Online Reputation Management (ORM) & Community Specialist – SEO / Forums | Part-Time, Remote



TYPE OF WORK: Part Time (20 to 30 hrs/week, agreed with you before starting), can grow to Full Time (40 hrs/week)

WAGE / SALARY: $8.00 to $9.00 per hour, based on experience

HOURS PER WEEK: 20 to 30

LOCATION: Remote



WHY THIS ROLE

- Long-term role with a growing US brand, not a one-off project

- 20 to 30 hours per week, agreed with you before starting, and can grow to 40, with the rate reviewed as the scope grows

- Fixed daily block, Monday to Friday

- Paid on schedule through Wise

- Paid assessment: shortlisted candidates are paid for the 2-hour test, whether or not they move forward



ABOUT US

We are a US-based brand selling car covers and automotive accessories through our own website, Amazon, and eBay.



POSITION OVERVIEW

We're looking for an Online Reputation Management specialist to strengthen our brand's presence in online communities and improve what people see when they search our brand name.



Your main focus: monitor and join relevant forums, spot reputation risks early, and help legitimate positive or neutral content rank above negative results over time.



This is not a customer-service or review-reply role.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

Community Forums

- Find forums and communities where people discuss our brand, products, competitors, or industry

- Monitor brand mentions, complaints, misinformation, and product questions

- Join discussions with helpful, natural, non-promotional replies

- Flag forum threads that rank for our brand name and recommend how to handle them

- Escalate legal threats, safety complaints, refund disputes, or coordinated attacks



Branded Search & Suppression

- Track page-one and page-two Google results for priority brand searches

- Identify negative URLs and how likely they are to be outranked

- Build and optimize legitimate brand assets (profiles, listings, articles, videos, interviews)

- Coordinate branded content that can take more first-page positions

- D
 whether a result should be corrected, removed, responded to, or outranked



Content & Reporting

- Write briefs for articles, FAQs, company profiles, and customer stories

- Support legitimate third-party placements and interviews

- Keep a simple weekly tracker: negative URL positions, positive assets, new mentions, actions taken, and next steps



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- You have personally moved at least one negative search result down and can show proof

- 2+ years in ORM, community management, or branded SEO (1+ year is fine if you have strong, specific examples)

- Hands-on experience in online forums or communities

- Experience tracking branded search results and URL positions

- Good written English and the ability to match each community's tone

- Basic SEO knowledge (search intent, links, authority, indexing)

- Knowing when a public reply would make things worse



NICE TO HAVE

- ORM for an e-commerce or consumer brand

- Digital PR, contributor articles, or editorial mentions

- Google Business Profile, Trustpilot, BBB, Reddit, or industry forums

- Ahrefs, Semrush, Google Search Console, or rank-tracking tools



PROHIBITED TACTICS

We only use legitimate, sustainable methods. Not allowed:

- Fake accounts, fake identities, or fake reviews

- Review gating or incentives for positive reviews only

- Mass posting, automated comments, or spam links

- Harassment or coordinated reporting campaigns

- Hiding a company affiliation when a platform requires it

- False claims about competitors

- Promising guaranteed removals or rankings



WORK ARRANGEMENT

- Remote, part-time contractor

- 20 to 30 hrs/week (Mon–Fri), agreed with you before starting. Can grow to 40 based on performance and workload

- Your daily hours fall within 7:00 AM–3:30 PM US Pacific Time (10:00 PM–6:30 AM PH Time). The exact block is set with your manager

- Weekly progress report

- During training, public replies and new community activity are approved before posting



HOW TO APPLY

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph or
 
 NOT apply to 



This round we are shortlisting only applicants who have personally moved a negative search result down for a brand. If you have not done that yet, this role is not a fit right now.



1. Put COVERLAND at the start of your application (subject line or first line)

2. Attach your resume

3. Answer the 3 questions below in your own words. Do not reuse wording from this post. Keep Q2 and Q3 under 120 words each

4. End your application with this line: NEGATIVE: followed by the number of URLs you marked negative in Q1



Applications missing any of these four are not reviewed.



Q1. Live check (about 15 minutes)

Open an incognito window and search Google for: coverland reviews

List the top 10 organic results in order, skipping ads. Mark each one positive, neutral, or negative. Write the date and the city you searched from. Then name the one URL you would work on first and say why in one line.



Q2. Your first move

For the URL you picked in Q1, what would you do in your first week, and what would you not do? If you posted anything publicly, would you disclose your connection to the brand?



Q3. Your own case

Describe one negative result you personally pushed down. Give the search query, the type of site, its position when you started, its position when you finished, how many months it took, the tool you used to track it, and what you did yourself. Attach one piece of proof, such as a redacted rank tracker screenshot or report. You may anonymize the brand, but the numbers must be real. Do not count a result that only moved temporarily or disappeared because of a search location change.



HOW WE CHECK

We check your Q1 list against the live search results and verify your Q3 case before the paid assessment. Claims we cannot verify are treated as not done.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a paid 2-hour assessment.

title: Marketing & Operations Assistant
description:
Marketing & Operations Assistant — Remote, Part-Time



About Avenue:

Avenue is a digital marketing agency based in Portland, Oregon. We help purpose-driven organizations grow through thoughtful strategy, digital advertising, SEO, social media, and content.



We’re looking for a reliable, detail-oriented Marketing & Operations Assistant to support our digital marketing and operations teams. You’ll help organize information, prepare materials, coordinate tasks, and keep recurring work moving so our team has more time for strategy, client relationships, and agency growth.



This role is a good fit for someone with digital marketing experience who learns quickly, takes initiative, and enjoys making other people’s work easier. You’ll work directly with our internal team, with no direct client communication.



Hours and working arrangement

- Remote, ongoing part-time support, initially estimated at 10–30 hours per week.

- Hours and responsibilities will be agreed upon together and may evolve based on workload and your strengths.

- Our team works primarily during U.S. Pacific business hours. Please share your time zone, preferred schedule, and availability for overlap.

- Compensation will be discussed based on experience and scope. Please include your expected hourly rate when applying.



What you’ll support

We’ll begin with a defined set of responsibilities and expand from there. Potential areas of support include:



Marketing reporting and research

- Pull and organize data from marketing platforms and reporting dashboards.

- Populate reporting templates and check dates, calculations, formatting, and completeness.

- Flag notable changes or discrepancies and prepare preliminary observations for our team’s review.

- Research relevant industry news, marketing platform updates, and client business developments, providing concise summaries and source links.

- Gather project updates and priorities to help prepare draft weekly client
s. Our account leads will add strategic context and finalize the messaging.



Project coordination

- Turn meeting notes and transcripts into clear action items.

- Create and update tasks in Teamwork, confirming owners and deadlines where needed.

- Maintain organized project files and flag missing information, upcoming deadlines, or blockers.

- Document recurring workflows and suggest practical ways to improve efficiency.



Operations and data support

- Track outstanding invoices and prepare follow-up drafts for our operations team.

- Collect and organize sales and other internal business data.

- Maintain spreadsheets and records for Avenue and Avenue Foundation.

- Organize Foundation application information into individual worksheets or review templates so applications are ready for the team to evaluate.



Creative, presentations, and internal marketing

Depending on your experience, you may also:

- Format and improve presentation slides using approved content and brand guidelines.

- Help refresh templates for monthly reports and annual strategic planning presentations, making information easier to understand visually.

- Create or adapt social media graphics and ad creative from approved briefs.

- Help organize Avenue’s content calendar and prepare newsletter and social media drafts.

- Follow Avenue’s brand voice and incorporate team feedback.



You do not need to be an expert in every area. Please tell us where your strengths are, particularly if you have presentation design, graphic design, or writing experience.



What we’re looking for

- Previous experience supporting digital marketing work, with familiarity with at least one advertising or analytics platform, such as Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, or Google Analytics.

- A basic understanding of marketing metrics such as impressions, clicks, click-through rate, and conversions.

- Strong spreadsheet skills and careful attention to data accuracy.

- Clear written English and the ability to summarize information concisely.

- Strong organization and the ability to manage tasks across multiple projects.

- A proactive, service-oriented approach: you anticipate needs, follow through, and look for ways to reduce the team’s workload.

- Ability to learn established processes quickly and complete work independently after initial guidance.

- Good judgment about when to proceed, ask questions, or flag an issue, including when working outside our team’s hours.

- Reliable communication, internet access, and follow-through.

- Discretion when handling confidential agency and client information. A signed nondisclosure agreement will be required.



Helpful additional experience

- Marketing agency experience.

- Teamwork or similar project management tools.

- Google Workspace, Canva, presentation software, reporting dashboards,
 marketing platforms, or social scheduling tools.

- Adapting writing and visuals to an established brand.

- Using AI tools thoughtfully to support research, drafting, or workflow efficiency, with human review for accuracy and adherence to our confidentiality requirements.



What success looks like

Your work helps our team spend less time gathering information, organizing details, and completing routine production tasks. Materials are accurate and ready for review, tasks stay current, and questions or issues are communicated early.



Over time, you build familiarity with our workflows and take ownership of recurring responsibilities with less oversight.



How to apply



Please include:

- A brief introduction and summary of your relevant experience.

- The responsibilities above that best match your strengths.

- The marketing platforms and tools you have used, with examples of what you did in them.

- Your availability, time zone, preferred working hours, and expected hourly rate.

- One or two relevant work samples, with confidential information removed.

- A short example of how you handled an unclear task or a blocker when your manager was unavailable.

title: Marketing & Social Media Manager
description:
Great at turning ideas into content people actually want to read and watch? Castle Automations is looking for a creative Marketing & Social Media Manager who can bring our brand to life through graphics, videos, and compelling writing.



ABOUT CASTLE AUTOMATIONS

We connect US small businesses with remote professionals. Our core services focus on lead generation, appointment setting, and closing, with additional support in bookkeeping, accounting, coordination, social media, and other business roles.



ABOUT THE ROLE

Your main focus will be creating content and managing our social media presence. You’ll develop ideas, write captions, design graphics, edit short-form videos, and publish content that helps business owners understand our services. You should understand how content supports marketing goals, builds trust, and encourages potential clients to reach out.



RESPONSIBILITIES

• Plan and maintain a content calendar aligned with our brand and target audience.  

• Create social media graphics, carousels, short-form videos, and other visual content.  

• Write clear, engaging captions, video scripts, and promotional content.  

• Turn our services, client feedback, and team insights into useful content.  

• Repurpose existing materials into fresh posts across different platforms.  

• Schedule and publish posts, maintain consistent branding, and respond to relevant comments and inquiries.  

• Track content performance and use the results to improve future posts.  

• Coordinate with our team to gather ideas, updates, and materials for content creation.



QUALIFICATIONS

• Proven experience in social media management and hands-on content creation.  

• A strong portfolio of graphics, videos, and written content you personally created.  

• Proficiency in Canva and video editing tools such as CapCut or Adobe applications.  

• Strong English writing skills and the ability to make business topics easy to understand.  

• An understanding of content marketing, audience targeting, and calls to action.  

• Ability to independently take content from idea to finished post.  

• Strong organization, attention to detail, and consistent follow-through on deadlines.  

• Reliable internet and availability for coordination within the 8 a.m.–5 p.m. Pacific Time window, as needed.



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

• Creating content for outsourcing, staffing, BPO, or virtual assistant companies.  

• Creating content aimed at US small business owners.  

• Turning service information into educational posts, client stories, and promotional content.



When applying, share examples of content you personally created and explain your contribution. If you have outsourcing industry experience, mention whether your content targeted business clients, job applicants, or both.

Virtual Business Development & Account Manager – Plumbing & HVAC Company (US Market)



The Role

We are looking for a sharp, confident, and self-driven Virtual Business Development & Account Manager to spearhead our outreach to residential and commercial property management companies. . As results come in, you will work directly with the owner to build and supervise a small outreach team. This role has a clear path into a senior management position.

 • Think strategically and creatively about how to find and approach property management companies

 • Build targeted lead lists from scratch

 • Conduct outbound calls and
 campaigns to decision-makers

 • Present a growth plan to the owner with actionable steps to scale outreach

 • Gradually take ownership of hiring and supervising an outreach team

 • Report results, track performance, and continuously improve the process



Who We’re Looking For



 • Neutral, accent-free English — you will be speaking directly with US-based property managers and decision-makers

 • Confident and direct on the phone — not shy, not passive

 • Self-starter with a hunter mentality — you don’t wait to be told what to do next

 • Experience in B2B outreach, account management, or business development, ideally in the US market

 • Ability to build systems and processes, not just execute tasks

 • Long-term mindset — we are looking for someone who wants to grow with us for years, not months



What We Offer



 • 100% remote position — work from home

 • Competitive salary negotiable based on experience ($1,200–$1,600/month to start)

 • Performance bonus for every new account closed

 • A real leadership path — you will build and manage your own team

 • A company that rewards performance and loyalty



To Apply

title: SEO & AI Search Support Specialist
description:
We are looking for an experienced SEO specialist to provide ongoing implementation, research and optimisation support across a portfolio of Shopify websites operating in Australia and international markets.



This is a hands-on role for someone who is comfortable working across technical SEO, eCommerce/Shopify, multi-level keyword research, performance optimisations, and newer search areas such as AI Search, GEO and AEO.



You will work alongside an experienced SEO lead who will provide strategic direction, priorities and governance. Your role will focus primarily on execution, analysis, QA and progressing optimisation work across multiple websites.



Scope of Work



Typical responsibilities will include:

- Technical SEO audits and follow-up checks

- Google Search Console analysis

- Semrush research and reporting

- Keyword research and topic clustering

- Competitor and search landscape analysis

- Metadata creation and optimisation

- Internal linking reviews and recommendations

- Crawlability and indexation analysis

- Navigation and site architecture reviews

- Schema markup reviews and validation

- Content optimisation recommendations

- Redirect mapping and migration support

- International SEO support, including hreflang tags etc

- Ongoing monitoring of organic search performance

- AI Search, GEO and AEO initiatives

- Entity optimisation and AI discoverability research

- Identifying issues with AI-generated content and search quality

- Supporting monthly and ad-hoc SEO reporting



The work will span ecommerce sites and product categories, so you must be comfortable switching between different websites, markets and priorities.



What We Are Looking For

- You should have at least 4+ years of technical SEO experience, ideally with Shopify websites.

- AI Search Experience



We are also looking for someone who understands how search is changing beyond traditional Google results.



You should have working knowledge of:

- AI Search

- Generative Engine Optimisation, or GEO

- Answer Engine Optimisation, or AEO

- Responsible use of AI for research, content analysis and optimisation



We are looking for someone who understands how AI is influencing organic search and can apply that knowledge to real ecommerce SEO work.



How You Will Work

This is not a role where you will be expected to create the entire SEO strategy independently. Strategic direction, major priorities and governance will be provided.



You will be expected to:

Follow defined SEO frameworks and processes

Complete work accurately and independently

Document findings clearly

Flag issues when something requires strategic review

Execute multiple tasks across different brands

Maintain strong attention to detail

Deliver work consistently without requiring constant supervision



To Apply

Please include:

A short summary of your SEO experience (1-2 paragraphs are enough, make them crisp)

Examples of ecommerce websites you have worked on with evidence

Your experience with Google Search Console, Semrush and Screaming Frog

An example of a technical SEO issue you identified and how you approached it

Your experience with AI Search, GEO or AEO



NOTE: Please avoid generic AI-generated applications. We will filter those out immediately i.e. taking our job description and flipping it around using AI doesn't speak well to us.



We are particularly interested in candidates who can demonstrate practical SEO experience, sound judgement and the ability to execute consistently across multiple websites. Please note there will be a technical interview with the SEO lead following the initial application.

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
CONTRACT UI/UX DESIGNER



=== ABOUT ESHOPPING GROUP ===



We're an e-commerce success story with operations across Sydney, Perth, and Brisbane, and an international team of 50+ spanning Australia, US, Philippines, Vietnam, China, and UK. Our portfolio includes seven brands across Beauty, Consumer Electronics, Pets, Surveillance, and Wellness. We operate out of WeWork on Pitt St with a flexible, fast-paced culture that rewards initiative and creativity.



=== WHY JOIN US? ===



- International team: Collaborate with 50+ people across six countries.

- Career growth alignment: We invest in people with vision and ambition.

- Expert mentoring: Learn from leaders recognised as Top 50 People in Australian ecommerce.

- Shared success: Your performance directly contributes to business growth.



=== THE ROLE ===



As we continue to scale multiple brands, we are seeking a Contract UI/UX Designer to join our team part time. This role sits within our in-house creative team and is ideal for a hands-on designer with strong UI/UX, ecommerce, and conversion rate optimisation (CRO) experience. You'll enjoy solving digital problems across multiple brands and turning ideas into intuitive, high-performing experiences.



You'll work closely with our Design & Experience Lead and broader creative, ecommerce, marketing, and product teams, taking ownership of digital projects from brief through to final design and developer handover.



A key part of the role will be supporting and executing our CRO program. You'll be expected to set up and launch A/B tests using platforms such as Elevate, Intelligems, or similar tools, conduct pre- and post-experiment data analysis, and translate insights into actionable design and optimisation recommendations.



=== KEY RESPONSIBILITIES ===



- UI/UX Design: Design and improve digital experiences across multiple ecommerce brands, including landing pages, website pages, collection experiences, navigation, and other website enhancements.



- Landing Pages & Website Design: Own projects from brief and initial UX thinking through to wireframes, high-fidelity UI design, prototyping, and developer handover, ensuring solutions are both user-friendly and commercially effective.



- UX & Customer Journeys: Map customer journeys, identify friction points, and translate user needs, behavioural insights, and business objectives into clear, intuitive digital experiences.



- CRO & A/B Testing: Identify optimisation opportunities, develop data-informed hypotheses, design test variations, and independently set up, configure, and launch A/B tests using Elevate, Intelligems, or similar experimentation platforms.



- Pre- & Post-Experiment Analysis: Establish performance baselines, assess opportunities using existing data, monitor experiment performance, and analyse results to evaluate outcomes and identify actionable recommendations for ongoing conversion optimisation.



- Design Systems: Work within and contribute to existing design systems and brand guidelines, ensuring consistency while adapting digital experiences to suit different brands and audiences.



- Shopify Design: Design and support front-end improvements across Shopify websites, with a strong understanding of the platform's capabilities and limitations.



- Creative Collaboration: Work closely within the creative team alongside digital designers, graphic designers, copywriters, and content creators to deliver cohesive, high-quality digital experiences.



- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with marketing, ecommerce, product, development, and data teams to deliver design solutions that balance user needs, brand, and commercial objectives.



=== REQUIREMENTS ===



- 2-4 years' experience as a UI/UX or Digital Designer, ideally within ecommerce, agency, or fast-paced digital environments.

- Strong practical experience designing for ecommerce websites, with a portfolio demonstrating real-world website, landing page, and UX work.

- Advanced Figma skills, with experience creating wireframes, high-fidelity designs, prototypes, and developer-ready handovers.

- Strong Shopify experience and a solid understanding of working within Shopify's front-end environment.

- Hands-on A/B testing experience, including setting up, configuring, and launching experiments in Elevate, Intelligems, or similar CRO and experimentation platforms.

- Confident with pre- and post-experiment data analysis, including establishing performance baselines, evaluating test results, interpreting key ecommerce metrics, and making data-informed recommendations.

- Strong understanding of CRO principles, experimentation methodology, hypothesis development, and how to design tests that balance user experience with commercial objectives.

- Strong understanding of UX principles, information architecture, user journeys, interaction design, typography, layout, visual hierarchy, and responsive design.

- Ability to take ownership of projects from brief through to final design and developer handover, while working independently and managing deadlines.

- Comfortable balancing user needs, brand requirements, and commercial objectives when making design decisions.

- Strong communication skills and a collaborative, proactive mindset.

- Basic understanding of HTML/CSS and how front-end designs are implemented is highly beneficial.

- Ability to manage multiple projects, brands, and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.



=== HIGHLY REGARDED ===



- Experience using GA4, Rebuy, and other ecommerce analytics and optimisation tools.

- Experience using customer data, behavioural insights, user research, and qualitative feedback to identify conversion opportunities.

- Experience working across multiple brands or sub-brands.

- Experience contributing to or maintaining design systems.

- Experience utilising AI-powered tools to support design, research, ideation, or creative workflows.



=== BENEFITS ===



- Competitive remuneration package based on experience.

- Professional development and mentoring.

- Fast-paced, innovative, and dynamic culture.

- Shared success model: your wins are the business's wins.



=== HOW TO APPLY ===



If this sounds like the role you've been waiting for, we want to meet you! Submit:



- Your CV.

- A portfolio showcasing your ecommerce UI/UX, website, landing page, and digital design work.

- Examples of A/B testing or CRO projects you've worked on, including your role in setting up experiments, analysing results, and applying insights to improve performance.



Please include "eShopping" in the subject line of your application.



We can't wait to see your work!

title: Spanish-Speaking Medical Virtual Assistant
description:
• Pay: USD 750 a month base, plus performance incentives with no cap. Our top performers take home USD 1,300 to 1,500 a month.

• Shift: Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 6 PM US Eastern (10 PM to 7 AM in Manila), with some weekend shifts for coverage

• Benefits: HMO from your third month, flexible paid time off

• Where: fully remote, from a quiet room at home

• Languages: fluent spoken Spanish and English. You call patients in both.



A CALL, FOR EXAMPLE

Your first call of the day is to a woman in her sixties with COPD who speaks only Spanish. Her health system referred her to us last week. She asks how you got her number, and says her daughter usually deals with her doctors. In Spanish, you explain who we are and how our team can help her stay well at home, answer her questions, and book her first visit. Your next call is in English.



THE JOB

Health systems across the US refer older patients with heart failure or COPD to us, often after a hospital stay. Many of them speak Spanish. You call them, explain in plain words how our doctors, nurses and respiratory therapists can care for them at home, and book their first video visit. For a patient who speaks Spanish, you are the first person at AnsibleHealth they can talk to in their own language.



You make 45 to 60 calls a day. Most go to voi
, and about a dozen become real conversations. Some patients are wary, some are tired of doctors, some just want someone to listen. Your job is to help each one d
 whether to join, and to get them to a first visit within a week or so. Between calls you schedule visits, keep patient records up to date and work with our clinical team.



ABOUT ANSIBLEHEALTH

AnsibleHealth is a US medical group for people living with serious heart and lung disease, such as heart failure and COPD. Health systems and health plans send us their patients, often right after a hospital stay. Our own doctors, nurse practitioners, nurses and respiratory therapists then look after them at home by video and phone: we adjust medicines, treat flare-ups early, teach patients and their families, and are on call day and night. The goal is fewer trips back to the hospital. We were founded in 2021, are backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, First Round Capital and AlleyCorp, and our team works across the United States and the Philippines.



WHAT YOU NEED



• Fluent spoken Spanish that a Spanish-speaking patient in the US understands the first time, including medicine names, numbers and times

• Clear spoken English that a US patient understands the first time

• 2 or more years on the phone in customer service or healthcare

• Comfort with clinical topics: nursing or other clinical training, or healthcare work where you talked with patients about their conditions

• A quiet room, internet of 30 Mbps or faster, and a backup for outages

• Availability for this shift for the long term

A healthcare degree, US healthcare accounts, sales or appointment-setting experience, or calls handled in Spanish at work are a plus.



This is a phone job with daily targets, not back-office or
 work. If you like talking with people and helping them say yes to care, you will do well here.



HOW TO APPLY (ABOUT 20 MINUTES)



1. Apply only at 
 . Applications sent any other way are not reviewed.

2. Answer a few quick questions in English.

3. Complete the Spanish section of the form. Its instructions are below, in Spanish only.

4. Record your voice on the form, first in English and then in Spanish. Each time you read three lines from a real call, then answer a patient in your own words (about ten minutes in all).

5. Give your earliest start date and the notice you owe your current employer.



EN ESPAÑOL

Esta parte del anuncio está solo en español, a propósito: en este trabajo usted llama a pacientes que hablan español. En la solicitud le pedimos tres cosas en español:



1. Escribir la palabra clave. Cuando el formulario le pida la palabra clave, escriba GIRASOL.

2. Responder por escrito una pregunta breve.

3. Grabar su voz: leer tres frases de una llamada real y responderle a una paciente con sus propias palabras.



If you are shortlisted, we
 you a link to book a 15-minute call with our recruiter.

title: Business Development & Consulting Associate
description:
We are seeking a commercially minded, analytical and proactive Business Development & Consulting Associate to support Meridian's business growth, strategic partnerships, consulting engagements and executive advisory services.



This is not a traditional virtual assistant or appointment-setting position. The successful candidate will work directly with the Principal & CEO to identify and develop qualified commercial opportunities, prepare professional consulting proposals, create executive-level presentations, conduct business research and support client engagements.



The ideal candidate combines strong business acumen, analytical capabilities, professional communication, relationship development and independent execution. We are looking for someone who can identify opportunities, recommend actions and drive initiatives forward.



**1. Business Development and Prospect Intelligence**



- Research and identify prospective clients across Meridian's target industries and markets.

- Identify relevant decision-makers, executive priorities, business challenges and commercial opportunities.

- Qualify prospects based on strategic fit, business needs and potential engagement value.

- Leverage 
, LinkedIn, AI-generated prospect intelligence and other approved research tools.

- Develop personalized executive outreach
s, LinkedIn messages and follow-up communications.

- Execute approved business development campaigns.

- Conduct professional outbound calls to prospective clients, partners and business contacts.

- Send personalized voice notes and video messages through approved communication channels, identifying yourself as a representative of Meridian Operations Group.

- Prepare researched, personalized voice-note scripts for the Principal & CEO to record.

- Coordinate executive voice-note outreach, track responses and manage follow-up activities.

- Schedule qualified discovery calls and business meetings.

- Re-engage stalled opportunities and maintain ongoing communication with prospective clients.

- Escalate high-value opportunities and strategic relationships for direct executive involvement.

- Prioritize qualified commercial conversations over outreach volume.



**2. Consulting Proposal Development**



- Lead the preparation and revision of professional consulting proposals based on discovery calls, meeting transcripts, client requirements and executive direction.

- Translate business challenges into clearly articulated problem statements, objectives and proposed solutions.

- Draft executive summaries, engagement scopes, deliverables, implementation approaches and statements of work.

- Incorporate approved pricing, commercial terms and engagement structures.

- Identify information gaps, assumptions, dependencies and potential risks.

- Coordinate proposal revisions, deadlines and follow-up communications.

- Maintain proposal templates and reusable business development materials.

- Coordinate final formatting, proofreading and version control with the Executive & Business Operations Assistant.



**3. Executive Presentations and Consulting Deliverables**



- Develop professional, executive-level PowerPoint presentations for prospective clients, existing clients, strategic partners and speaking engagements.

- Translate complex business information into clear, compelling narratives and visual presentations.

- Prepare executive summaries, business cases, assessment reports, strategic roadmaps, dashboards and status reports.

- Conduct company, industry, competitor and operational research to support consulting recommendations.

- Analyze business information and identify relevant trends, opportunities and potential risks.

- Develop educational presentations, workshop materials and supporting resources.

- Ensure presentations and deliverables reflect Meridian's professional standards and approved methodologies.

- Coordinate final formatting and document administration with the Executive & Business Operations Assistant.



**4. Strategic Partnerships and Relationship Development**



- Identify potential strategic partners, referral sources, complementary consulting firms, technology providers, logistics providers and professional services organizations.

- Identify subcontracting opportunities with larger consulting firms and prime contractors.

- Research potential partners and develop personalized partnership proposals and outreach strategies.

- Prepare capability presentations, introductory materials and partnership pitches.

- Coordinate introductory meetings and manage relationship follow-ups.

- Identify opportunities for joint workshops, webinars, educational programs and collaborative business development.

- Evaluate networking events based on access to decision-makers and potential commercial value.

- Identify additional prospect meetings, strategic introductions and networking opportunities around approved executive business trips.



**5. Supplier Diversity, Procurement and Contract Opportunities**



- Proactively research corporate, government and institutional procurement opportunities.

- Monitor relevant RFPs, RFQs, RFIs, sources-sought notices and contracting opportunities.

- Evaluate opportunities based on eligibility, strategic fit, scope, potential contract value, competition, delivery requirements and submission deadlines.

- Recommend whether Meridian should pursue, decline or monitor identified opportunities.

- Identify and establish relationships with procurement leaders, supplier diversity professionals, category managers and prime contractors.

- Develop draft RFP responses, technical proposals, capability statements and supporting business cases.

- Coordinate proposal requirements, supporting documentation and submission activities with the Executive & Business Operations Assistant.

- Identify commercially valuable certifications and corporate supplier registration opportunities.

- Track procurement opportunities through submission, evaluation and follow-up.

- Monitor relevant procurement channels, including 
, Illinois BidBuy, City of Chicago and Cook County procurement portals, NMSDC networks, corporate supplier portals, university procurement platforms and prime contractor opportunities.



**6. Community and Professional Association Outreach**



- Research relevant
 groups, LinkedIn communities, professional associations, chambers of commerce, entrepreneur networks and industry organizations.

- Identify community administrators, program directors, association leaders and decision-makers.

- Develop personalized outreach positioning Meridian as a valuable educational and strategic advisory resource.

- Pursue opportunities for guest presentations, educational workshops, webinars, panel discussions and expert Q&A sessions.

- Identify opportunities for recurring educational contributions within relevant business communities.

- Develop relationships with business accelerators, incubators and small business support organizations.

- Evaluate community opportunities based on audience alignment, credibility and potential commercial value.

- Maintain professional communication and comply with community participation guidelines.



**7. Speaking, Corporate Education and Workshop Development**



- Identify paid speaking engagements, corporate training opportunities, executive education programs and professional development opportunities.

- Research conferences, calls for speakers, speaker application deadlines and compensation opportunities.

- Develop customized speaking pitches, speaker applications, presentation abstracts and educational proposals.

- Prepare workshop descriptions, learning objectives and supporting educational materials.

- Identify and engage universities, business schools, entrepreneurship centers, corporate learning and development teams and professional associations.

- Pursue opportunities for guest lectures, masterclasses, executive workshops, corporate training and recurring educational programs.

- Maintain a library of Meridian's speaking topics, educational offerings and workshop descriptions.

- Evaluate unpaid speaking opportunities based on audience quality, visibility and potential business development value.

- Develop pathways for converting educational engagements into paid workshops, strategic advisory services and consulting opportunities.



**8. Media Relations and Executive Visibility**



- Research relevant local, regional and national television programs, radio stations, podcasts, publications and digital media platforms.

- Identify producers, journalists, editors, podcast hosts and media decision-makers.

- Monitor industry developments and business news for timely expert commentary opportunities.

- Develop personalized media pitches, segment concepts, interview topics and expert commentary proposals.

- Pursue opportunities for recurring television segments, expert contributor roles, guest columns and educational media partnerships.

- Maintain media contact lists and track outreach, responses and follow-up activities.

- Prepare executive briefing documents, interview talking points and supporting research.

- Support the development and maintenance of speaker profiles, media kits and executive credibility materials.

- Coordinate confirmed appearances with the Executive & Business Operations Assistant and relevant team members.



**9. Executive Roundtables and Meridian-Led Educational Programs**



- Identify and recruit qualified executives and business leaders for invitation-only executive roundtables.

- Research participants and develop personalized invitations.

- Conduct professional outreach and follow-up to secure participation.

- Research industry-specific challenges and develop relevant discussion topics.

- Prepare executive briefing materials, discussion guides and supporting research.

- Identify potential guest experts, panelists and strategic participants.

- Develop post-event relationship management and commercial follow-up strategies.

- Identify potential consulting, advisory and partnership opportunities resulting from roundtable discussions.

- Support the development of Meridian-led webinars, workshops, masterclasses and educational programs.

- Coordinate event requirements and participant information with the Executive & Business Operations Assistant.



**10. CRM and Commercial Pipeline Management**



- Maintain accurate commercial opportunity records within GoHighLevel.

- Own opportunity progression, commercial follow-up activities and next actions.

- Track prospective clients, partnerships, procurement opportunities, speaking engagements, media opportunities and educational engagements.

- Maintain accurate records of communications, meetings, proposal status, potential engagement value and deadlines.

- Follow up on qualified inquiries generated through social media, newsletters, websites, events and other marketing activities.

- Identify stalled opportunities and recommend appropriate re-engagement strategies.

- Coordinate CRM handoffs with the Executive & Business Operations Assistant.

- Maintain compliance with applicable calling, messaging, consent and opt-out requirements.

- Ensure commercial opportunities receive timely and appropriate follow-up.



**11. Client Engagement and Consulting Support**



- Support the preparation and execution of consulting and strategic advisory engagements.

- Conduct client-specific research and support information-gathering activities.

- Review meeting transcripts, discovery notes and supporting documentation.

- Prepare assessment materials, business analyses, project plans and draft client deliverables.

- Identify operational challenges, information gaps, potential risks and dependencies.

- Prepare client meeting briefs, executive status updates and progress presentations.

- Support the development of strategic recommendations under executive direction.

- Coordinate client deliverable requirements and project administration with the Executive & Business Operations Assistant.

- Maintain professional standards and confidentiality across all client engagements.



**12. Industry Intelligence, Market Research and AI Integration**



- Review, validate and leverage AI-generated industry intelligence, market research and competitive insights.

- Monitor relevant industry trends, emerging business challenges, executive priorities and market developments.

- Conduct supplemental industry, competitor and company research to support qualified commercial opportunities, proposals and client engagements.

- Translate industry developments into targeted prospect outreach, strategic partnerships, educational offerings, media pitches and consulting opportunities.

- Identify emerging business challenges that align with Meridian's advisory and consulting capabilities.

- Provide substantive industry insights to support newsletters, educational programs and thought leadership initiatives.

- Recommend commercially relevant actions based on research findings.

- Use approved AI tools to improve research efficiency, proposal development, presentation preparation and business analysis.

- Validate AI-generated claims, statistics, research findings and recommendations before incorporating them into business communications or client deliverables.



**13. Process Improvement and Performance Reporting**



- Provide process-owner input for the development and maintenance of commercial SOPs.

- Review and validate documented business development and consulting workflows.

- Identify opportunities to improve commercial efficiency, outreach effectiveness and proposal turnaround times.

- Recommend improvements to business development processes, research workflows and supporting technology.

- Prepare weekly reports covering qualified prospects, pipeline progression, proposals, procurement opportunities, strategic partnerships, speaking engagements, media opportunities and educational initiatives.

- Identify risks, obstacles and decisions requiring executive attention.

- Recommend weekly priorities and commercially relevant next actions.

title: Experienced DTC Ecommerce AI Video Editor
description:
WHO WE ARE

We are a DTC e-commerce brand making multi-six figures a month, run by two Italian founders. We are the leader of our niche in the Italian market, we are aiming for seven figures a month, and we will soon enter the US market to take what belongs to us.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for sharp DTC editors with a real instinct for ads, who can deliver both quantity and quality without much direction.

- Full time: 40 hours a week, 8 hours a day, from Monday to Friday.

- One batch a day (one script with 3 or 4 hook variations), finished and ready to launch. That makes 5 batches every week, although it also depends on the type of ad.



REQUIREMENTS

- At least 2 years as an editor for a DTC brand that sells physical products and makes multi-six or seven figures.

- Results you can prove, with data on how much your creatives spent, and a portfolio of ads, not reels.

- You can edit without a storyboard: from the brief, you understand which visuals to use, when and how.

- You can create a video from scratch, fully with AI, without any clips from us.

- You know formats like song ads, AI drama, yapper ads and VSLs in depth.

- You use Higgsfield, ElevenLabs, HeyGen and Premiere Pro.



DO NOT APPLY IF (you would slow down the hiring of the people who deserve it)

- You have not worked with large DTC e-commerce brands on paid advertising and you have no results to prove it.

- You have not made AI part of your workflow and you do not know the platforms.

- You can only do one format and you ignore the others.

- You cannot handle fast feedback and competition inside the team.

- You only wait for the end of the month to get paid while doing the minimum. The last person who did that lasted 2 days.



BONUS

We want people who stay with us over time and help us scale, and we will be happy to pay them bonuses.

- Every $10K spent on your ads at target CPA or lower = a $100 bonus.

  There is no cap: $150K spent = a $1,500 bonus.

  A top editor can earn $2,500 to $3,000 a month in total.

- Leaderboard: every week the ranking of our editors is published on ClickUp, and the people in the top spots receive special gifts (for example Amazon gift cards and company merchandise).



BENEFITS

- You work closely with the founders and learn from them.

- We have an enterprise partnership with Higgsfield, with one call a month with their AI trainers to improve your workflows.

- We pay for courses worth thousands of dollars. Even if you leave one day, you will keep valuable skills.

- Creative strategist positions will open soon. We are not promising anything, but the best editors will be called for dedicated interviews.



DOWNSIDES (for us they are not)

- People who do not want to work, or who cannot keep the pace, do not last.

- You take responsibility for your work. We see ourselves as generals, not emperors: we are always on the front line and we learn from our mistakes.

- For now we do not train anyone from zero. You need to bring value from day 0, not after months.



HOW TO APPLY

Fill out the Google Form and follow the instructions to the letter: 

The people we select will have a short call with me, just to meet in person and see if there is mutual trust. After that comes a paid trial task, and finally a longer and more intensive hiring call.

The process can take a week or a single day. It depends only on how fast you give us feedback and reply to us.

title: Remote Senior MSP IT Support Engineer (L2/L3) — Vancouver hours
description:
We are a managed IT provider in Vancouver, Canada, looking for a full-time L2/L3 technician who wants to stay and grow with us. You will speak with clients, carry issues through to a verified fix, improve the tools behind the work, and help us build the next stage of our technical team.



We support approximately 20 customer organizations, 200–250 users and 20 servers. You will get to know their environments and have room to make a lasting impact. Our plan is to settle the first new technician into our clients and workflows, then add a second as the business grows. We would value someone who wants to help shape the team's standards and support new colleagues over time.



This is a fully remote role for applicants residing in the Philippines. No relocation to Canada is required. You must be able to work the stated Vancouver hours.



What you'll do



- Own client calls,
 and Autotask tickets from first response through verified resolution. Respond to service
 the same business day, keep clients informed and leave notes another technician can use.

- Solve everyday and complex MSP issues across workstations, printers, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Windows Server, Active Directory, Entra ID, Azure, Private Cloud, DNS/DHCP, networks and backups.

- Administer our deployed Kaseya stack, especially Autotask PSA, Datto RMM and IT Glue. Work across our security and backup toolset, including Dark Web ID, EDR, AV, BullPhish, SaaSAlerts, MDR, RocketCyber, INKY, Graphus, Datto Backup and Unified Backup. Improve Autotask queues, workflows and templates; build or adjust Datto RMM monitoring, patching, jobs, policies and automation with testing, approval and rollback.

- Handle basic business firewall work, including rules, VPN, NAT and logs, on Meraki or another platform. Coordinate alerts, escalations and ticket ownership with our NOC and SOC. Put security into each decision.

- Use lighter support periods for assigned projects, documentation and service improvements. Look for repeatable work that can be made faster and more reliable through safe Autotask or Datto RMM automation, then test and measure the result. You will have a full-time mix of client support and planned improvement work.

- Use approved AI tools to help with diagnosis, research, scripting, documentation and routine work. Spot practical opportunities to save time while protecting client information, checking AI output against source systems and keeping a person accountable for each ticket and change.



What you bring



- Strong hands-on L2 MSP experience, sound L3 judgment, and a track record of owning issues through a verified outcome.

- Direct experience administering Autotask PSA, Datto RMM and IT Glue. Experience with several of the listed security and backup products, plus the ability to learn the rest. We will ask which workflows, templates, policies or automations you personally changed and tested.

- Working experience in both Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace; practical Windows Server, identity, Azure/Private Cloud, networking and security skills. Meraki experience is welcome. Solid firewall fundamentals on another business platform and a clear ability to learn Meraki also count.

- Careful security judgment in everyday support: protect client data, use least privilege and MFA, recognize suspicious activity, escalate i
 promptly, and follow approval, test and rollback steps before changing systems.

- Ability to use AI tools responsibly in technical work and interest in finding efficiencies through automation or AI. Bring an example of a task you improved, what you automated or used AI for, how much time or rework it saved, and how you verified the result.

- Excellent spoken and written English for frequent live client calls, clear updates and dependable follow-through. You enjoy learning, sharing knowledge and improving how a team works.

- A reliable work computer, quiet space, independent backup internet and backup power. You are willing to follow our written security and work-profile policies; we will agree on device-management terms before installing tools on a personal computer.

- Full-time, 40 hours per week. Availability Monday–Friday, 7:30 a.m.–5:00 p.m. Vancouver local time, following the Vancouver clock (UTC−8 in winter and UTC−7 in summer).



An annual performance bonus may be available based on results, contribution to the business's growth and reliable ownership of the role, under written terms agreed before an offer. Benefits, equipment, overtime, holiday coverage, engagement structure and compensation will be discussed with finalists.



Apply



Apply in English using this link:





Upload your CV and complete every field in that form. This Manatal application is our single hiring intake. Shortlisted applicants complete a practical exercise and interviews. Productive trial or training work will be paid.

title: Shopify Product Sourcing & Dropshipping VA
description:
Wealthy Elite Boss is looking for an experienced Shopify Product Sourcing & Dropshipping Virtual Assistant to help manage the product sourcing and backend product-management side of our ecommerce store.



This role is ideal for someone who already has hands-on experience working with Shopify and dropshipping vendors and understands how to evaluate products, organize product information, work with supplier data, and maintain a clean, accurate Shopify catalog.



You will be provided with a **fixed list of approved vendors** as well as specific product-sourcing criteria after hire.



Your primary responsibility will be to identify products from those vendors that meet our requirements, submit your selections for approval, and then upload approved products into Shopify.



We sell across multiple product categories, so you must be comfortable researching and organizing a variety of products rather than working in only one niche.



Primary Responsibilities



- Source products from our approved vendor list according to provided criteria

- Review products for quality, fit, pricing, variants, availability, images, and overall suitability

- Submit sourced products for approval before publishing them to the store

- Calculate retail pricing and profit margins using our established pricing rules

- Upload approved products into Shopify

- Properly organize:

  - Product titles

  - Images

  - Variants

  - Pricing

  - Tags

  - Collections

  - Vendor information

  - Product details

- Maintain clean and consistent product organization within Shopify

- Monitor existing products for:

  - Supplier price changes

  - Stock availability

  - Discontinued products

  - Broken or unavailable variants

  - Product-image issues

  - Incorrect pricing

- Update Shopify listings when vendor information changes

- Identify and report issues before they negatively affect the customer experience

- Keep accurate records of sourced, approved, uploaded, and unavailable products

- Follow established product-sourcing and store-management procedures

- Communicate consistently regarding product approvals, vendor issues, and store updates



What We Are Looking For



You should have **real experience working with Shopify and dropshipping vendors**.



This is not an entry-level Shopify role.



You should be comfortable navigating Shopify independently and understand the relationship between supplier information and the customer-facing product listing.



Strong candidates will have experience with:



- Shopify product management

- Dropshipping suppliers/vendors

- Product sourcing and product research

- Product variants

- Collections and tags

- Supplier pricing

- Retail pricing and margins

- Inventory monitoring

- Product availability

- Product uploads

- Backend store organization

- Ecommerce quality control



Important



This position is primarily focused on **product sourcing and Shopify backend management**.



You will not be expected to create a full marketing strategy or write advanced SEO copy.



However, you should be able to recognize when product information is incomplete, inaccurate, poorly organized, or unsuitable for the store.



You must also be comfortable following specific instructions and sourcing criteria.



Work Style



We are looking for someone who is:



- Organized

- Detail-oriented

- Reliable

- Proactive

- Comfortable working independently

- Able to follow established criteria

- Able to manage repetitive tasks without sacrificing accuracy

- Comfortable asking questions when something is unclear

- Able to identify problems before they become larger issues



The schedule is part-time and can be flexible, but deadlines, product-monitoring responsibilities, and communication expectations must be met consistently.



Compensation



The budget for this position is up to $700 USD per month, depending on experience, availability, and the final scope of responsibilities.



Please include your expected monthly rate in your application.



How to Apply



Please answer the following questions in your application:



1. How many years of experience do you have with Shopify?

2. How many Shopify stores have you worked on?

3. What types of dropshipping vendors or suppliers have you worked with?

4. Describe your process for d
 whether a product is worth adding to a Shopify store.

5. Have you previously monitored supplier pricing, inventory, discontinued products, or product variants?

6. Are you comfortable calculating retail pricing using a company's predetermined pricing and profit-margin rules?

7. What parts of Shopify product management can you handle independently?

8. Please provide examples of Shopify stores or ecommerce projects you have worked on, if available.

9. What is your current availability?

10. What monthly compensation are you requesting for a part-time role?



Required Application Detail



To show that you read the full job posting, please begin your application with:



“PRODUCT SOURCE READY”



Applications that do not include this phrase may not be reviewed.



We are looking to bring the right person in as soon as possible, so applicants who are available to begin quickly are encouraged to apply.



Thank you,  

Wealthy Elite Boss

description:

title: Senior Tax Accountant Australia
description:

Your Team: Financial Accounting & Tax ANZ

Your Location: Philippines

Your Group Division: Corporate Advantage Australia Pty Ltd



Position Overview



How your role makes a difference

The Senior Tax Accountant is responsible for managing complex tax compliance and advisory engagements, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and adherence to relevant legislation. This role involves preparing and reviewing tax returns, providing technical guidance to junior staff, identifying tax planning opportunities, and supporting clients in achieving optimal tax outcomes. • Liaising with clients, tax authorities, and other stakeholders to provide excellent customer service

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills

Working at adva.group means being part of a dynamic, forward-thinking organization that values innovation and collaboration. Our team is made up of highly skilled and experienced professionals who are committed to delivering exceptional results for our clients. We offer a supportive and inclusive work environment where team members are encouraged to grow and develop their skills and careers.

At the adva.group, we are dedicated to making a positive impact on the businesses and communities we serve, and we strive to create a culture of excellence in everything we do.



Capability



Experience and Qualifications

To be successful in this role, the ideal candidate will have the following experience and qualifications:

• Has strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Demonstrates loyalty, professionalism, and a desire for long-term growth within the organisation.

• Possesses experience in accounting, as well as previous roles such as secretary, receptionist, personal assistant, or administrative assistant.

• Exhibits adaptability, willingness to face challenges, and strong time-management skills.

• Is proficient in Microsoft Office, Gsuite, accounting software, and other office productivity tools.

• Maintains professional presentability and meticulous attention to detail.

• Can effectively manage multiple tasks across diverse corporate portfolios.

• Has a mind for career and progression - we’re looking for someone to invest in!

title: B2B Appointment Setter (Outbound Sales)
description:
B2B APPOINTMENT SETTER (OUTBOUND SALES)



Remote in the Philippines

Full-time contractor

US$1,800 to US$2,000/month plus bonuses

80 hours of paid time off a year



I’m Nathan, founder of Dealer Lux. We build websites for independent hot tub, pool and fireplace dealers across North America. I’m looking for someone who can reach a busy dealer, hear what’s going on in their showroom and book a demo worth their time.



Several of our Philippines teammates have been here since 2022. Some now lead departments. The team organizes hangouts, and we sponsor games and prizes.



I’ll teach you the product and we’ll review calls together. I run the demos today. Once you’re consistently bringing in good meetings, you could start running demos too. If we grow the team, you could help lead it.



WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Check the dealer’s website and HubSpot history for one good reason to call.

• Confirm who’s coming and what they want to see. Give me a short handoff and follow up on missed demos.



WHO I’M LOOKING FOR

You’ve cold-called US business owners or managers and booked B2B meetings. If you’ve sold to dealerships, sold websites or digital marketing, or won over owners in another industry, I’d love to hear about it.



SCHEDULE AND PAY

Monday to Friday, 7 a.m. to 4 p.m. US Pacific, with an hour for lunch. You’ll need a quiet place to call and reliable internet for the overnight shift.



You’ll earn US$50 when a qualified dealer attends their first demo and US$250 for each website customer you bring in who pays the build fee. We pay the top of the base range for a track record of getting owners to attend.



HOW TO APPLY

Sign in with Google to upload your résumé and tell us about one campaign you worked. Use the Google account where you’d like to hear from me. It takes about five minutes. I’ll start reviewing applications the week of November 30 and reach out to set up 15-minute calls.

title: Experienced Clipping Campaign Manager / VA — Content Rewards & Fraud Prevention**
description:
We are hiring an experienced clipping campaign manager to run campaigns for an established trading education and mentorship brand.



You will manage the process from creator recruitment and campaign setup through submission reviews, fraud checks, payout recommendations, and performance reporting. Our goal is to generate legitimate traffic, qualified leads, and paying customers while protecting the campaign budget.



**Experienced applicants only. You must have personally managed paid clipping campaigns using Content Rewards and be able to demonstrate your work.**



Experience working with traders, futures/forex educators, financial creators, or high-ticket mentorship businesses is a strong advantage.



**What you will manage**



- Set up and manage Content Rewards campaigns, including briefs, approved footage, requirements, budgets, and payout limits.

- Recruit, screen, and onboard reliable clippers. Verify ownership of publishing accounts and review relevant work and available audience data.

- Maintain assignments, deadlines, draft approvals, revisions, live post links, and creator communication.

- Review clips for accuracy, quality, branding, appropriate disclosures, and a clear next step.

- Investigate signs of bought views, bots, engagement exchanges, undisclosed boosting, duplicate submissions, or manipulated evidence.

- Check available native analytics, traffic sources, audience geography, watch/retention data, and account history.

- Prepare evidence-based recommendations to approve, investigate, or reject submissions and payment requests. Escalate issues to platform support when needed.

- Set up creator-specific tracking and preserve referral information through landing pages, applications, bookings, and customer records.

- Match customer bonuses to verified payments and refunds under the agreed rules.

- Maintain a budget and performance dashboard covering delivery, traffic, qualified applications, attended calls, customers, collections, refunds, and acquisition cost.

- Recommend improvements based on actual results.



We need someone who can run the daily operation independently, keep records organized, and bring problems to us with evidence and a proposed solution.



**Required experience**



- Personally managed at least two paid clipping campaigns, including submission reviews and creator payment checks.

title: Process Improvement, Operations, and Documentation Specialist
description:
Process Improvement, Operations, and Documentation Specialist



Platform: OnlineJobs.ph

Job Type: Full-Time (40 hrs/week)

Starting Salary: $350 – $500 USD / month (Negotiable up to $550–$600 for highly qualified candidates)



About Us

We are a growing US-based consultancy specializing in strategic business operations, process improvement, and organizational growth. We build scalable systems, refine client workflows, and deliver structured advisory solutions. We value direct communication, clear processes, long-term working relationships, and respect for our team members' professional growth.



Job Overview

We are looking for an analytical, systems-minded Operations, Process Improvement & Documentation VA. In this role, your primary focus will be analyzing existing workflows, identifying bottlenecks to drive process improvements, and creating clean, standardized Operating Procedures (SOPs).



Alongside process optimization and documentation, you will manage day-to-day administrative operations, handle client email follow-ups inside our CRM, and execute our social media content calendar. This role is ideal for a detail-oriented candidate who loves eliminating operational friction and building structured business systems.



Key Responsibilities

• Process Improvement & Workflow Optimization (Core Focus): Audit current operations, identify inefficiencies or redundant steps, and recommend practical process improvements to increase speed, accuracy, and overall workflow quality.

• SOP Creation & Documentation: Turn Loom video walkthroughs, raw notes, and optimized workflows into clear, beautifully formatted, step-by-step Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) using Notion, Google Docs, or Tango. Maintain and organize our central operations library.

• Inbox & Client Follow-Ups: Monitor email inboxes, draft templated replies, send follow-ups to warm leads/clients, and log communications inside our CRM (GoHighLevel/Google Workspace).

• Social Media Execution: Schedule approved posts across social channels (using Canva, Metricool, Buffer, or native platforms), format captions, monitor basic comments/DMs, and keep our publishing calendar on track.

• General Administrative Support: Assist with calendar scheduling, file organization in Google Drive, basic data entry, and ad-hoc research tasks to keep daily operations running smoothly.



Required Qualifications

• Experience: 2+ years of experience in Operations Support, Process Improvement, Business Process Mapping, or Administrative Operations.

• Process Improvement & Documentation Mastery: Proven ability to analyze workflows, map out complex processes, and write detailed SOPs and operational manuals.

• Tool Proficiency:

 - Documentation & Ops: Notion, Google Docs, Loom, Tango, or process mapping tools (Miro, Lucidchart, Whimsical).

 - Workspace & CRM: Google Workspace (Gmail, Drive, Sheets) & GoHighLevel (or standard CRM platforms).

 - Social & Design: Basic Canva skills and familiarity with social media schedulers (Metricool, Buffer, or Meta Suite).

• Skills & Reliability: Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, excellent written English, exceptional attention to detail, reliable high-speed internet, and power backup.



Salary & Benefits

• Monthly Salary: $350 to $500 USD/month (negotiable up to $550–$600 for fully qualified candidates), with rapid, performance-based increases.

• 13th-Month Pay Included: Full 13th-month bonus paid every December (prorated based on hire date).

• Performance Reviews: Annual review with opportunities for merit-based raises and bonuses based on performance and company growth.



To apply, please send a message with the exact subject line:

"Process Improvement & Ops VA - Ready"



In your message, please include:

1. A brief 2-sentence summary of your specific experience in process improvement and writing SOPs.

2. An example of a workflow or process you previously analyzed and improved, including the tools you used to document it.

3. A quick description of how you identify bottlenecks or inefficiencies in a daily workflow.





(Note: Applications without the exact subject line or complete answers to the questions above will be automatically discarded.)
