title: Sales Closer – Local Service Business Clients – $4-15/hr + Uncapped Commission (US Hours)
description:
We run The GRID — a done-for-you growth system for local service businesses in the US (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, and similar trades). We're hiring one person to run our outbound sales process end to end: reach out to business owners, show them a real, specific problem with their online presence (their website, their Google listing, how they handle missed calls), and close them into a paid engagement.



This is not a script-reading, dial-and-transfer job. You'll need to actually understand what we do well enough to look at a business's website and Google listing and explain, in plain language, what's likely costing them money — then close the deal yourself, with no handoff. If your background is high-volume generic cold-calling or appointment-setting with no interest in understanding the product, please don't apply — you won't pass the first screen and it'll waste both our time.



What you'll do:



Call and
 US local service business owners, opening with a specific, real observation about their business — never a generic pitch. Review a prospect's website and Google Business Profile before or during the call to find real gaps (no online booking, thin reviews, outdated site, no after-hours coverage). Walk owners through our guarantee ($2,000 in real findings, in writing, or we pay them $1,000) as the core of the pitch. Close the deal yourself — there is no separate closer, you are the closer. Log every call and outcome accurately.



What you need:



Fluent, clear spoken English. You will be on live calls with US business owners. This is the single hard requirement — your application video is how we check it, not your resume. Real closing experience — not just appointment-setting or lead qualification. Comfortable learning enough about websites, Google Business Profiles, and basic CRM tools (we use GoHighLevel) to talk credibly about a business's gaps — you don't need to be technical. Able to work US business hours — state your actual overlap in hours in your application. A quiet space and reliable internet for calls; reliable and self-directed day to day.



Pay:



Open range: $6/hr up to a $15/hr cap, plus uncapped commission on every deal you close, from day one.



As a rough monthly reference at full-time hours (160 hrs/month), that's roughly $960–$2,400/month base, before any commission — commission is where real earning happens here, and there's no ceiling on it. Lower base + higher commission will out-earn higher base + lower commission for anyone actually closing deals. If you'd rather have more guaranteed income with a smaller cut per deal, that's available too, capped at $15/hr base.



Tell us in your application where on this $4-15/hr range you'd want to start, and why. There's no wrong answer — we want to see how you think about risk and reward before we ever get on a call.



Hours: 15-30+/week to start, scaling with output and results.



How to apply:



Start your application with the word PHOENIX — if it doesn't start with that word, we assume you didn't read the full post and we won't review it.

Send a 60-90 second voice or video recording telling us about your sales/closing experience and why you'd be good at this. Voice note is fine — we're listening for how you communicate, not production quality.

In writing, tell us: your available hours and overlap with US business hours (Eastern or Central time), and where on the $6-15/hr range you'd want to start and why.



Applications that skip the PHOENIX keyword or the voice/video clip will not be reviewed, regardless of resume.

San Diego Premier Auto Group is an established and growing car rental company based in San Diego, California, USA. We manage approximately 40 vehicles, primarily through Turo and other rental platforms.

- Experience with Google Workspace, dispatch coordination, or operational reporting.

title: System Administrator
description:
PFS Global is seeking to hire a remote, tech savvy System Administrator to work for our full-service business management company which is located in California, United States. This is a dual-purpose role focused on modernizing our infrastructure and providing high-level technical support. You will be instrumental in our transition from legacy on-premise setups to a cloud-first architecture. We are looking to fill this position immediately. Please only apply if you meet the below qualifications:

Qualifications:

1. Must type 55 WPM (you will be tested)

2. Must have minimum internet speeds of 25/25 mbps (download/upload)

3. Team player with excellent communication skills in English

4. Full-time availability at 40 hours / week , Mon - Fri (Pacific Standard Time)

Key Responsibilities:

• Project Work (70%): Infrastructure deployment, Azure management, automation, and cloud migration.

• Support/Help Desk (30%): User troubleshooting, device enrollment, and ticketing via Jira.

• Infrastructure Modernization: Decommissioning on-prem servers and migrating to serverless/cloud environments.

• Device Management: Enrolling workstations, managing user attributes and device policies.

• Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs): Creating clear, step-by-step documentation for common IT tasks (e.g., "How to Reset a Password," "How to Setup OpenVPN").

• AI & Automation: Using AI to generate scripts and automations like PowerShell scripts that audit fleet compliance, restructure file shares, and manage group memberships.



Technical Requirements (The "Must-Haves")

The ideal candidate doesn't need 10 years of experience, but they must have a fundamental, deep understanding of how the internet and networking work.

Cloud & Virtualization

• Azure: Managing Virtual Machines, Files, and Microsoft Entra ID.

• Google Workspace: Admin-level management including Gmail, Drive & App Script

• Identity Management: User management in Google Workspace, Microsoft Entra, and Active Directory

• Virtual Desktops: Supporting On-Prem RDS Environments and/or Azure Virtual Desktop



Productivity & Automation

• Scripting: Familiarity with automation via scripting languages (Bash, PowerShell, JavaScript, Python, etc.)

• Configuration Management: understanding of config file formats (JSON, YAML, INI, etc.). Also, OS Configuration like environmental variables and “PATH” management.

• Ticketing: Experience with Jira Service Management.

Security-conscious: you think before you act. Least privilege on accounts, handle data carefully, don't leave passwords in plain text.

Candidate Persona & Culture Fit

• We want someone who is genuinely curious about technology and spends their free time learning how things work under the hood.

• We value fundamental knowledge and "hunger" over specific years of experience in a single tool.

• Must be able to follow technical flowcharts and documentation to execute complex tasks independently.

• High-proficiency in English (required for system management and global team collaboration).

o You will need to create flowcharts and documentation in English as well, so writing is important.



If you meet the above qualifications, and the description above sounds like the position that you are looking for, please apply and forward us your typing (WPM) and internet (upload/download) speeds in order to get an interview.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
About Scaledforce

Scaledforce is a Canadian staffing company that helps growing Canadian businesses scale by hiring top-tier remote professionals. We focus on long-term placements, clear KPIs, and strong support so our team members can build stable, fulfilling and rewarding careers.



About the Client

You'll be joining a Canadian edtech startup based in Vancouver: an online tutoring platform that helps people prepare for and pass the IELTS exam. The founder is hands-on, open to ideas, and looking for someone who brings marketing know-how he doesn't have yet. You'll be one of the company's first team members, with a real say in how the brand grows.



Job Overview

We're looking for a full-time, remote Executive Assistant to own the client's social media and help run their paid advertising. You'll take lesson content the founder creates and turn it into posts and videos across
, Instagram and YouTube, keep a close eye on Google Ads experiments and spend, and report clearly on what's working and what isn't.



This isn't a role with an established playbook. The company is new, and the founder is still learning what works in marketing, so he needs someone who can bring ideas, test them, and run with them without step-by-step direction. If you enjoy building something from the ground up, this is that role.



Work Schedule

• Monday to Friday 9am-5pm PT

• Aligned to Pacific Time (Vancouver) business hours

Please only apply if you're able to reliably work night shift long-term.



Salary & Incentives

Base Salary PHP 42,000 – 46,000 per month

Performance-based quarterly bonuses



Key Responsibilities

Social Media & Content

• Channel ownership — Manage the client's
, Instagram and YouTube accounts and keep a consistent, on-brand posting schedule.

• Content repurposing — Turn the founder's lesson content into posts, short-form clips, reels and YouTube videos.

• Video editing — Edit videos into polished, engaging content built for each platform.

• Community management — Respond to comments and messages promptly and in the brand's voice.

• Content performance — Track what's working and recommend what to make more (and less) of.

Paid Advertising (Google Ads)

• Campaign monitoring — Keep a close eye on Google Ads campaigns and spend, and flag issues early.

• Experiments — Help run tests across keywords, audiences, countries and creative as the ad budget grows.

• Reporting — Use Google Ads and Google Analytics to report clearly on results and what to test next, in plain language.

• Ad creation — Turn the winners from each experiment into new ads and ad copy.

Platform & Growth Support

• Learner's-eye feedback — Use the platform the way a learner would and give honest feedback on clarity, flow and messaging.

• Brand voice — Help shape how the company talks to its audience across every channel.

• AI content (growth area) — Learn and start using AI tools to create videos and ads, with training and support.



Qualifications

Required

• At least 2 years of experience in social media or content marketing for a brand or business

• Hands-on experience managing
, Instagram and YouTube accounts end to end

• Solid video editing skills (e.g., CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Canva), with a portfolio of work you can share

• Hands-on experience with Google Ads or other paid advertising: monitoring campaigns, reading results and making recommendations

• Comfortable using Google Analytics or similar reporting tools

• Excellent written and verbal English. You'll write captions, ad copy and replies every day

• Self-directed: you can take a rough brief and run with it without step-by-step instructions

• Reliable internet connection and a dedicated, quiet workspace

• Able to reliably work night shift (Pacific Time) long-term

Nice to Have

• Experience creating AI-generated videos or ads

• English teaching experience, or experience with the IELTS as a teacher or test-taker

• Experience marketing an online learning, edtech, app or subscription product

• Experience with Meta Ads or TikTok

• Familiarity with AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini); experience using AI for coding or automation is a bonus



Who Thrives in This Role

• You're a self-starter who brings ideas, not someone who waits to be handed a content calendar

• You're comfortable with “we don't know yet”. You like testing, learning and adjusting

• You share results honestly, the good and the bad

• You're curious about the numbers and like digging into what the data is telling you

• You want to grow your AI skills and stay ahead of new tools

• You care about education and helping learners reach their goals



Work-From-Home Requirements

• Laptop or PC with Intel i5 or equivalent

• Internet speed of at least 25 Mbps (upload & download)

• Noise-cancelling headset

• Power backup (UPS, generator, or nearby co-working space)

• Quiet, dedicated home workspace with a desk



Why Join Scaledforce

Benefits & Perks

• 13th Month Pay

• SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG

• HMO Health Insurance

• Paid Time Off + Sick Leave: 10 PTO days (accrued) + 5 sick days after probation

• Quarterly performance bonuses

• Annual salary increases based on performance

• Netflix subscription reimbursement

Career Growth

• Long-term, stable client placement at the ground floor of a growing company

• Room to grow from content and ads execution into owning the client's marketing

• Clear KPIs and structured onboarding

• Regular coaching, training, and performance feedback

• Supportive Canadian work culture



How to Apply

Please

• Link to your portfolio, or 2–3 examples of social content, videos or ads you've created

• Short video (1–2 minutes) introducing yourself and your marketing experience

• Subject line: SFIL Marketing Specialist – [Your Name]

title: Outreach & Programme Coordinator
description:
Position Overview

Zero Hunger Project is seeking an organized and community-focused Outreach and Programme Coordinator to grow our coalition, strengthen partner relationships, and coordinate programmes addressing hunger, food insecurity, and poverty.

The successful candidate will reach out to community organizations, post secondary institutions, governments, corporates, invite them to join our coalition, and support their ongoing engagement. They will also coordinate programme activities, host regular coalition meetings, and organize learning sessions for partner organizations and the clients and communities they serve.



Key Responsibilities:

Community Outreach and Coalition Development:

- Identify and engage community organizations, food programmes, social service agencies, educational institutions, governments and Corporations, and other potential coalition partners.

- Introduce Zero Hunger Project’s mission, explain the coalition’s purpose and benefits, and invite organizations to participate.

- Follow up with prospective members and coordinate onboarding.

- Maintain regular communication with members to understand their needs, priorities, and opportunities for collaboration.

- Represent Zero Hunger Project at community events, meetings, and networking opportunities.

- Maintain accurate records of contacts, outreach activities, membership, and engagement.



Programme Planning and Coordination:

- Work with the team and coalition partners to identify community needs and develop relevant programmes.

- Prepare programme plans outlining objectives, activities, schedules, responsibilities, budgets, and expected outcomes.

- Coordinate day-to-day delivery of workshops, community initiatives, and partner activities.

- Maintain a shared programme calendar and coordinate staff, volunteers, speakers, and resources.

- Monitor delivery, address operational challenges, and flag issues requiring leadership decisions.

Track approved programme expenses and provide supporting information to the finance lead.

- Gather participant and partner feedback to improve programme quality and relevance.



Coalition Meetings and Partner Engagement:

- Schedule and facilitate regular coalition meetings and programme working groups.

- Prepare agendas, coordinate presentations, and circulate meeting materials.

- Encourage inclusive discussions, knowledge sharing, and collaborative action.

- Record decisions and action items, assign follow-up responsibilities, and track commitments.

- Connect partners with relevant resources, expertise, and opportunities for joint initiatives.



Learning Sessions and Community Participation:

- Identify learning interests and needs among coalition members, clients, and community participants.

- Organize and host workshops, information sessions, and peer-learning activities.

- Recruit speakers and facilitators and coordinate practical, audience-appropriate content.

- Manage registration, invitations, reminders, venues or virtual platforms, and session materials.

- Coordinate accessibility accommodations and language support where needed and available.

- Create a welcoming environment that respects diverse backgrounds and lived experiences.



Communications, Monitoring, and Reporting

- Prepare member updates, programme announcements, invitations, and activity summaries.

- Work with the communications team to share approved programme updates and partner stories.

- Track outreach results, attendance, member participation, programme outputs, and participant feedback.

- Prepare regular reports outlining progress, achievements, challenges, and recommended improvements.

- Maintain organized programme records and handle participant and partner information responsibly.



Required Qualifications

- Education or relevant experience in community development, programme coordination, social services, nonprofit management, communications, or a related field.

- Experience is Sales and Marketing.

- Experience in community outreach, partnership development, or stakeholder engagement.

- Experience coordinating programmes, workshops, events, or community initiatives.

- Strong interpersonal skills and confidence approaching new organizations and building lasting relationships.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

- Ability to facilitate meetings and engage people with diverse perspectives.

- Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and consistent follow-through.

- Proficiency with spreadsheets, shared documents,
, and virtual meeting platforms.

- Ability to work independently and collaboratively with staff, volunteers, and partners.

- A commitment to addressing hunger and poverty through inclusive community engagement.



Preferred Qualifications

- Experience supporting a coalition, community network, or nonprofit programme.

- Familiarity with food security initiatives and community services.

- Experience engaging people with lived experience of food insecurity or poverty.

- Knowledge of accessible event planning and inclusive facilitation.

- Experience tracking budgets, evaluating activities, or preparing programme reports.

- Familiarity with CRM or contact management systems.

- Additional language skills relevant to the communities served.



Expected Outcomes

- A growing coalition with active and sustained member participation.

- Well-organized programmes that respond to community and partner needs.

- Regular, productive coalition meetings with clear follow-through.

- Accessible learning sessions that provide practical value to organizations and participants.

- Accurate records and timely reporting that support continuous programme improvement.



Working Conditions

- The role will involve working various hours including evening or weekend meetings and activities. Specific scheduling will be discussed during recruitment.



How to Apply

- Please submit your résumé and a brief cover letter outlining your outreach and programme coordination experience to 

- Zero Hunger Project welcomes applicants from diverse backgrounds, including people with lived experience of food insecurity or poverty. Accommodations are available upon request throughout the recruitment process.

Strong practical culinary background across different cuisines, products, and operating environments

Beverage operations or dining service experience

Experience leading distributed or remote culinary teams

Experience building training and succession pipelines

Experience standardizing culinary operations during growth, restructuring, or expansion



You'll Thrive Here If You...

title: Executive Operation Assistant
description:
# NOW HIRING: ROCKSTAR EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT & BUSINESS SYSTEMS COORDINATOR



**Location:** Philippines – 100% Remote  

**Employment:** Full-Time, Long-Term  

**Compensation:** $1,000 USD per month  

**Schedule:** 40 hours per week  

**Reports To:** Business Owner / CEO  

**Growth Opportunity:** Business Operations Manager



## ABOUT US



We are a growing entrepreneurial organization with multiple businesses across different industries, including:



- **Before & After-School Care:** Childcare, youth development, educational programming, and administrative services.

- **Coffee Brand:** Coffee products, brand development, e-commerce, distribution, and retail expansion.

- **Natural Formula:** A health and wellness company specializing in sea moss and wellness products.

- **Future Business Ventures:** Additional business opportunities as our organization continues to grow.



We are looking for an exceptional Executive Assistant who can help us build, organize, manage, and streamline the backend operations of our businesses.



## WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We are NOT looking for an average virtual assistant who simply completes assigned tasks.



We are looking for a ROCKSTAR!



Someone who is intelligent, resourceful, organized, proactive, and capable of turning ideas into reality.



We need someone who can look at a business, identify what is missing, determine what needs to be done, create a plan, and execute that plan without needing constant supervision.



The ideal candidate understands how to build business infrastructure, create systems, organize departments, establish procedures, and help businesses become more efficient and scalable.



We want someone who brings solutions, not just questions.



## PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES



### 1. Executive & Administrative Support



- Manage the CEO's calendar,
s, meetings, and appointments.

- Organize business priorities, deadlines, and responsibilities.

- Prepare professional
s, documents, presentations, and reports.

- Conduct research and gather information for business decisions.

- Follow up with employees, vendors, customers, and business partners.

- Maintain organized business records and documentation.

- Anticipate the business owner's needs.

- Reduce the business owner's daily administrative workload.



### 2. Business Infrastructure & Backend Development



- Evaluate the current structure of each business.

- Identify missing systems, departments, procedures, and resources.

- Build organized backend systems for each company.

- Develop Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

- Create business workflows, checklists, and operational manuals.

- Establish centralized document management systems.

- Develop organizational charts and departmental structures.

- Identify tasks that can be delegated, automated, or outsourced.

- Build systems that allow businesses to operate efficiently without constant involvement from the owner.



### 3. Project Management



- Turn business ideas into actionable plans.

- Create project timelines, milestones, and deadlines.

- Organize and manage multiple projects simultaneously.

- Track assignments and follow up until completion.

- Identify potential challenges before they become problems.

- Research solutions and recommend the best course of action.

- Coordinate with contractors, vendors, and team members.

- Provide regular updates on project progress.



### 4. Recruitment & Team Development



- Identify positions that each business needs to fill.

- Create job descriptions and hiring criteria.

- Research and recruit qualified candidates.

- Conduct initial candidate screenings and interviews.

- Assist with employee onboarding and training.

- Develop employee responsibilities and performance expectations.

- Create training manuals and onboarding procedures.

- Help build and eventually coordinate a team of virtual assistants and administrative professionals.

- Establish systems to track employee productivity and accountability.



### 5. Research & Business Development



- Conduct industry and competitor research.

- Research potential business opportunities.

- Identify suppliers, manufacturers, distributors, and vendors.

- Research potential partnerships and retail opportunities.

- Assist with business plans, proposals, and presentations.

- Research business licenses, certifications, and regulatory requirements.

- Identify potential grants, contracts, and funding opportunities.

- Present research in an organized, easy-to-understand format with actionable recommendations.



### 6. Technology, AI & Automation



- Identify opportunities to automate repetitive business tasks.

- Utilize artificial intelligence to improve productivity.

- Research and recommend software for each business.

- Set up project management and task tracking systems.

- Assist with CRM setup and management.

- Create automated reminders and follow-up systems.

- Develop business dashboards and reporting systems.

- Organize digital files, databases, and company resources.

- Continuously improve operational efficiency through technology.



### 7. E-Commerce & Product Business Support



- Assist with organizing online stores and e-commerce operations.

- Coordinate with suppliers, manufacturers, and fulfillment partners.

- Track inventory and product information.

- Assist with product launches and promotional campaigns.

- Research packaging, labeling, and distribution opportunities.

- Coordinate with website developers and marketing professionals.

- Organize wholesale and retail opportunities.

- Assist with customer service systems and order management.

- Monitor competitor products and pricing.



### 8. Financial & Business Administration



- Organize business expenses, invoices, and receipts.

- Maintain basic financial tracking spreadsheets.

- Monitor recurring subscriptions and business expenses.

- Assist with budget preparation and expense tracking.

- Coordinate with accountants and bookkeepers.

- Track outstanding invoices and payments.

- Maintain organized financial documentation.

- Prepare basic weekly and monthly business reports.



## MANDATORY QUALIFICATIONS



- Minimum of 3 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Administrative Manager, Project Coordinator, or similar position.

- Previous experience supporting business owners or entrepreneurs.

- Experience working with U.S.-based businesses.

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

- Strong organizational and project management skills.

- Ability to manage multiple businesses and projects simultaneously.

- Strong research and problem-solving abilities.

- Experience creating business systems, workflows, and SOPs.

- Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

- Strong understanding of AI and modern business technology.

- Ability to learn new software and systems quickly.

- Excellent attention to detail.

- Reliable computer, high-speed internet, and backup internet access.

- Availability to work during agreed U.S. business hours.



## REQUIRED SOFTWARE & TECHNICAL SKILLS

 and calendar management

 marketing platforms

## PREFERRED ADDITIONAL EXPERIENCE



- Business startup development.

- Building business systems from scratch.

- E-commerce and product-based businesses.

- Health and wellness brands.

- Childcare or educational businesses.

- Recruitment and human resources.

- Vendor and supplier management.

- Basic bookkeeping and financial administration.

- Digital marketing.

- Business licensing and compliance research.

- Wholesale and retail distribution.

- Managing other virtual assistants.



## PERSONALITY & CHARACTER REQUIREMENTS



The ideal candidate must be:



- Proactive.

- Resourceful.

- Highly organized.

- Self-motivated.

- Dependable.

- Trustworthy.

- A critical thinker.

- A natural problem-solver.

- Detail-oriented.

- Results-driven.

- Technology-savvy.

- A fast learner.

- An excellent communicator.

- Comfortable taking initiative.

- Capable of working independently.

- Passionate about business development and growth.



We want someone who takes ownership of their responsibilities and treats the success of the businesses as a personal responsibility.



## WHAT WE DO NOT WANT



- Someone who constantly needs step-by-step instructions.

- Someone who waits to be told what to do.

- Someone who needs repeated reminders.

- Someone who brings problems without researching potential solutions.

- Someone who cannot manage multiple priorities.

- Someone who is unwilling to learn new technology.

- Someone who completes tasks without understanding the bigger picture.

## OUR EXPECTATIONS

- Organize all company files and documentation.

title: Insurance Client Advocacy Specialist
description:
Insurance Client Advocacy Specialist (Part-Time – 20 Hours/Week)





Purpose



OCD Anxiety Centers is seeking an exceptionally charismatic, confident, persuasive, and results-driven individual to help prospective clients overcome insurance-related barriers to receiving treatment.



**We are looking for someone with the confidence, personality, communication skills, and persistence of a top-performing salesperson.**



This position is not entry-level. We are looking for an experienced professional with a strong background in sales, client advocacy, healthcare, insurance coordination, or high-volume telephone-based roles. Candidates must demonstrate exceptional communication, persuasion, negotiation, and problem-solving skills, along with the confidence and ability to independently manage complex client cases and insurance-related conversations.



The primary focus of this position will be working with Select Health clients to explore available pathways for accessing treatment at OCD Anxiety Centers, including network adequacy requests, network gap exceptions, single-case agreements, coverage appeals, and other applicable insurance access processes.



This individual must be exceptionally comfortable on the telephone, possess outstanding English communication skills, and demonstrate the persistence necessary to follow through until every assigned case reaches an appropriate resolution.



The position will begin as a part-time, 20-hour-per-week contract opportunity. Successful performance may lead to increased responsibilities and consideration for a permanent, full-time position.



## Key Performance Indicators and Reporting



The following performance expectations will apply during the initial pilot program.



### 1. Client Engagement and Insurance Coordination



- Work directly with a minimum of **2 Select Health clients per hour for at least 2.5 hours per day**, targeting 5 client interactions daily.

- Coordinate and calendar appointments with a minimum of **4–5 Select Health clients per day** to facilitate conversations with their insurance company.

- Participate in joint conversations with clients and insurance representatives to help navigate insurance requirements and advocate for access to treatment.

- Maintain professional, confident, and persuasive communication throughout each interaction.

- These expectations may be increased or decreased as the Company determines the actual time required to complete the insurance access process.



### 2. Complete Insurance Access Process



- Complete **100% of the established insurance access workflow** for every assigned client.

- Ensure each client progresses through all applicable stages, including initial outreach, scheduling, insurance communication, required documentation, follow-up, escalation, and final resolution.

- Maintain accurate documentation of every step completed.

- Ensure no assigned client is left without a documented next action or final outcome.

- Continue following up until all applicable steps have been completed, the case is resolved, or an authorized decision is made to close or escalate the case.



### 3. Weekly Client Processing Expectations



- Successfully process a minimum of **4 Select Health client cases per week** through the established insurance access workflow.

- A processed case must have all applicable required steps completed, with the outcome appropriately documented.

- Track the number of clients who receive approvals, denials, exceptions, single-case agreements, or other coverage determinations.

- Weekly processing requirements may be adjusted based on case complexity, insurance response times, and average processing duration.



### 4. Follow-Through and Accountability



- Maintain consistent communication with clients and insurance representatives.

- Ensure 100% of active cases have a documented status, next step, and scheduled follow-up when applicable.

- Complete all assigned follow-up activities by their established deadlines.

- Promptly escalate cases involving obstacles, unanswered requests, or insurance decisions requiring additional assistance.

- Demonstrate exceptional persistence, professionalism, confidence, and ownership of every assigned case.



### 5. Daily and Weekly Reporting



Maintain an accurate tracking system that includes:



- Number of clients contacted.

- Number of client appointments scheduled.

- Number of joint client and insurance company calls completed.

- Number of client cases initiated and fully processed.

- Number of insurance approvals and denials.

- Number of clients ultimately authorized to receive treatment at OCD Anxiety Centers.

- Outstanding cases, barriers, next steps, and follow-up dates.

- Average time required to process each case.



Provide leadership with a weekly summary of progress, results, challenges, and opportunities to improve efficiency.



### 6. Pilot Program Evaluation and Growth



These performance expectations represent initial benchmarks and may be modified based on actual processing time, client availability, insurer response times, and pilot results.



The Company will evaluate the effectiveness of this position based on productivity, consistency, communication quality, complete workflow execution, and success in helping clients obtain appropriate access to treatment.



Successful performance may create opportunities to increase client volume, expand responsibilities, and transition the position into a permanent, full-time opportunity.



## Core Competencies



- **Sales-Oriented Confidence:** Demonstrates the confidence and assertiveness of a successful salesperson. Comfortable initiating conversations, asking difficult questions, handling objections, and advocating for appropriate outcomes.

- **Exceptional Charisma:** Naturally connects with people, establishes immediate rapport, and makes clients feel comfortable, respected, and supported.

- **Outstanding English Communication:** Demonstrates exceptional spoken and written English skills, including clear articulation, fluency, professional grammar, active listening, and the ability to explain complex information in understandable terms.

- **Persuasion and Influence:** Communicates compellingly and professionally, presents accurate information effectively, and works toward productive resolutions without becoming confrontational.

- **Telephone Confidence:** Comfortable leading conversations with insurance representatives, requesting supervisors, asking challenging questions, and professionally escalating matters when appropriate.

- **Persistence and Resilience:** Remains motivated when encountering resistance, denials, delays, or complicated processes.

title: Ecommerce Virtual Assistant (Customer Support, Operations & AI)

title: Email Marketing & Content Specialist
description:
Email Marketing & Content Specialist



Company: Wise Agent

Location: Philippines, remote

Type: Full-time, hourly contractor

Pay: 8–11 USD per hour, based on experience, writing quality, and demonstrated results

Hours: 40 paid hours per week

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m.–4:30 p.m. Arizona time, including a 30-minute unpaid lunch break. This is 11:00 p.m.–7:30 a.m. the following morning in the Philippines. The Friday shift ends Saturday morning.

Performance reviews: At 3, 6, and 12 months, with opportunities for pay increases based on performance.





About Wise Agent

Wise Agent is an established real estate technology company helping agents, teams, and brokers stay organized, automate follow-up, build relationships, and grow their businesses. Our platform combines CRM, marketing, transaction management, websites, and other tools with 24/7 human support.

We have a collaborative team in Arizona and the Philippines and are looking for someone interested in a stable, long-term role.





About the role

You will take ownership of
 marketing and written content, including our weekly
, The Hoot, our monthly newsletter, blogs, product announcements, and promotional campaigns.

Every piece should help the reader understand a problem, see a practical solution, and take a relevant next step. You will also measure performance, run thoughtful tests, and recommend improvements that help us grow our audience, generate trials, and acquire paying members.

You should bring hands-on
 marketing experience. We will train you on Wise Agent, our audience, brand voice, tools, and internal processes.





What you’ll do

 marketing and newsletters

Write, build, test, and schedule The Hoot, monthly newsletters, product announcements, and promotional
s.

Develop subject lines, preview text, clear messaging, and effective calls to action.

Segment audiences so prospects, trial users, paying members, and partners receive relevant messages.

Maintain the
 calendar and coordinate deadlines, assets, and approvals.

Check recipients, personalization, links, tracking, spelling, and mobile presentation before every send.





Testing and improvement

Maintain an A/B testing plan for subject lines, preview text, content, calls to action, and sending days or times.

Define the hypothesis, success metric, and review period before each test.

Test one main variable at a time using comparable audience groups.

Document findings, recognize inconclusive results, and apply what you learn.

Look beyond open rates to meaningful engagement and business outcomes.





Campaigns and audience growth

Build and improve nurture, onboarding, reengagement, and event promotion campaigns.

Identify opportunities to attract relevant subscribers through useful content, webinars, partnerships, and signup forms.

Monitor list health, bounces, unsubscribes, and complaints.

Respect subscription preferences and coordinate delivery or technical issues with the appropriate team.





Content writing and product research

Write and publish useful blogs, feature announcements, and supporting promotional copy.

Support our Becoming a Wise Agent webinar and podcast series through audience-building
s and outreach copy.

Learn the product through training, help articles, and hands-on practice.

Follow relevant real estate news, coaches, and industry conversations, then connect useful topics to problems Wise Agent helps solve.

Verify product claims and write in our warm, practical, clear, and helpful voice.





Analytics and reporting

Use
 reports, Google Analytics 4, and available CRM data to understand campaign performance.

Create consistent campaign tracking links and work with development to verify attribution.

Report completed trials and new paying members separately from clicks and other engagement.

Produce a concise weekly report explaining what happened, what you learned, and what you recommend next.

Clearly flag missing data or tracking limitations.





Responsible use of AI

Use approved AI tools to research, brainstorm, improve drafts, analyze summarized reports, and develop test ideas.

Personally verify product details, calculations, sources, and conclusions.

Be able to explain your work and the reasoning behind your recommendations.

Protect confidential company and member information.

Seek relevant training and apply new knowledge to your work.





How you’ll work with the team

You: Own written content,
 production, segmentation, testing, campaign coordination, and
 performance reporting.

Our Marketing Graphic Designer: Creates graphics and visual assets, edits assigned short videos, and manages daily social publishing.

Our Marketing Manager: Sets priorities, provides guidance, and approves campaigns.

Our Development team and Advertising Specialist: Support tracking, technical implementation, and paid advertising.

You will provide clear creative briefs and coordinate copy, graphics, links, deadlines, and approvals so campaigns stay organized.





What we’re looking for

At least 2 years of hands-on
 marketing experience, including writing, building, sending, and evaluating campaigns.

Excellent written English and the ability to make software benefits clear to a nontechnical audience.

Examples of newsletters, promotional
s, or automated campaigns you personally created.

Practical understanding of segmentation, A/B testing, automation, list health, and deliverability.

Working knowledge of GA4 campaign reporting and conversion measurement.

Strong attention to detail and a habit of checking your own work.

Ability to organize recurring deadlines, apply feedback, and communicate blockers early.

Consistent availability and responsiveness throughout the agreed working hours.

Reliable internet, suitable equipment, and a backup plan for connection or power interruptions.

Interest in learning, taking ownership, and contributing to a long-term team.





Helpful experience

Real estate, SaaS, CRM, or technology marketing

Trial-to-paid conversion campaigns

Webinar, podcast, association, affiliate, or partner promotion

Blog publishing and basic SEO

Wise Agent or another CRM and
 marketing platform





How we work

We're a remote team across very different time zones, so reliable communication matters as much as the work itself.

Timekeeping: Clock in and out accurately every shift, and post your breaks in the designated Slack channel.

Daily check-ins: Share what you're working on at the start of your shift and what you finished at the end.

Responsiveness: Reply to Slack messages during your shift. If you'll be late, absent, or need to step away, tell your manager before it happens.

Blockers: If you're stuck for more than 30 minutes, ask. We'd rather answer a question early than redo work later.





What success looks like in the first 90 days

First 30 days: Complete product training. Learn our audience, brand voice, and approval process. Deliver assigned
s and content accurately and on time.

By day 60: Own production of The Hoot and the monthly newsletter with progressively fewer revisions. Keep projects moving without repeated reminders. Establish a performance baseline and weekly scorecard.

By day 90: Run documented tests and explain how the findings influence future campaigns. Identify and implement approved improvements to segmentation, audience growth, or conversion.

We will agree on measurable improvement targets after reviewing the baseline and available tracking.





How to apply

Use this subject line:

 Marketing Specialist | [Your Name]

Please include:

1. Your resume and a short introduction. After researching Wise Agent, explain what we do, who our customers are, and why this role interests you.

2. Two relevant
 or newsletter samples. Explain the audience, objective, and what you personally wrote, built, or managed.

3. One blog or longer writing sample.

4. One campaign improvement example. Describe what you tested or changed, the results, and what you learned. Include actual numbers where available and remove confidential information.

5. Any current work commitments that would overlap with these hours.

Keep your samples clearly labeled and make sure all links are accessible.





Bonus: Include a short Loom video introducing yourself and walking us through one
 campaign you worked on, what you contributed, and how you measured its success.



Selected applicants will complete a short, writing and
 marketing exercise before Zoom interviews.

title: Photo Editor: culling and Lightroom editing (family, newborn, pet and wedding photography) | 20 hours a week
description:
We are Little Things Photography, a New Zealand photography studio. We photograph families, newborns and pets, and we also edit weddings. Our style is outdoor, natural and documentary. We want an editor who loves that look and wants steady, ongoing work.



THE WORK

- Culling: choosing the best images in our own web-based cull tool.

- Editing in Lightroom to our style, so a whole gallery looks consistent.

- Retouching in Photoshop, such as cleaning up small distractions. This is a bonus, and we will teach our standards.



Culling and editing come first.



HOW THE WORK COMES TO YOU

You take your own jobs from the editing queue in our web app, when you are ready. Nobody assigns you work. Your time is logged in the app.



HOURS AND PAY

₱325 an hour to start, rising with experience. 20 hours a week (about ₱28,000 a month), with the potential for hours to increase in the future as we grow. You choose when you work.



WHAT YOU NEED

- A computer that can run Lightroom Classic, with a modern web browser for our cull tool

- Reliable internet

- A smartphone (iPhone or Android) for our staff app, which we use for jobs and messages



PAID TEST FIRST

Two short paid stages. Stage 1: cull about 200 frames in our cull tool, paid ₱250. Stage 2, if stage 1 goes well: edit 10 images in Lightroom, paid ₱250. Test pay is sent by PayPal. If it goes well, you start on real jobs.



YOU ARE A GOOD FIT IF YOU

- have edited full galleries of people photography (portrait sessions or weddings) in Lightroom Classic

- cull well, keeping the frames with the right expression and moment

- keep colour and skin tones consistent across a whole gallery

- tell us early if something is wrong, and ask when a brief is unclear



Wedding experience and Photoshop retouching are a plus.



HOW TO APPLY

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph with:

1. Your answers to the three questions below

2. A link to a full set you edited from one shoot, not only your best five

3. Your usual working hours



We only review applications that answer all three questions.



THREE QUESTIONS

1. How many full galleries (portrait sessions or weddings) have you edited start to finish, and which Lightroom version do you use? Give the number first, then one line.

2. For the last shoot you culled, how many frames did you start with, how many did you keep, how many hours did it take, and which tool did you use?

3. How do you keep colour and skin tones consistent across a gallery, and how long did the edit of your last full gallery take?

You will report directly to our Ordering & Purchasing Manager. She trains you, sets your priorities each day, and checks your work while you learn. Your first job is to support her. The role grows into sales as you master ordering.

2. Support our in-house designer, as your manager directs. Prepare quotes, follow up on drawings and selections, track samples, and keep every Bella Casa client moving to the next step.

This is a long-term role with a published career path. We are not looking for someone to answer and transfer. We are looking for people who like talking to customers, can solve the problem on the call, and want to grow with one company.

Answer inbound calls — Scheduling, billing questions, service questions, reservices and bookings for all of our branches.

Work our
 and text inbox — Clear, friendly, accurate replies, worked to empty every shift.

Help customers who want to cancel — Understand why, and make a genuine effort to keep them.

title: Administrative Assistant - Virtual - Path to Executive Assistant
description:
Role Title: Administrative Assistant, with a defined path to Executive Assistant

Company: Out of Site Bookkeeping

Reports To: CEO

Department: Operations

Location: Remote

Work Schedule: Full-time, 40 hours/week (8am–4pm CST)

Compensation: $3.00 USD/hour to start, with increases as you grow into the Executive Assistant role

Core Tools: Gmail, Google Drive, Asana, QuickBooks Online, Double, Go High Level (CRM), WhatsApp, Slack



About Us:

Out of Site Bookkeeping is a fully remote firm providing full-charge bookkeeping, consulting, and tax preparation to small businesses across the United States. Our team runs on Slack, Asana, and Double, values efficient communication without unnecessary meetings, and believes in ownership: every team member owns their work and the processes behind it.



Role Purpose:

We are looking for the CEO's right hand. This role owns the firm's administrative, client-facing, and internal financial operations so the CEO can focus on client delivery, advisory work, and growth.

This is not a “wait for instructions” role. You will be trusted to run your areas independently: d
 what needs to happen, follow through without reminders, catch problems before they cost the firm money, and keep the CEO informed. You will own outcomes, not just tasks.



How This Role Operates:

• If you see it, you own it. When something falls inside your areas, handle it. Don't wait to be asked or assigned.

• Manage your own work. Plan your week, set your own priorities, and track everything in Asana so the CEO can see status without asking.

• Close the loop. When a request is done, say so. When something will be late, say so before it's late.

• Bring solutions, not just problems. When you escalate, include what happened, your recommendation, and what you need from the CEO.

• Think one step ahead. Look for what's coming next (deadlines, client needs, gaps in a process) and act on it early.

• Be reachable and plan for coverage. Stay responsive in Slack throughout your shift. Request time off in advance and set up coverage so nothing stalls while you're away.



Decision Authority:

• Handle it on your own: Routine
s, scheduling and rescheduling, Asana updates, collections follow-ups, onboarding and offboarding steps, file organization, team recognition messages, and screening applicants against agreed criteria.

• Handle it, then inform the CEO: Fixes to billing or bookkeeping errors, updates to SOPs, and process improvements within your own areas.

• Bring a recommendation and get approval first: Anything that changes client pricing or fees, refunds or credits, client complaints or disputes, new tools or spending, hiring decisions, and commitments of the CEO's time outside normal scheduling.



Key Responsibilities



1. Support the CEO:

You own the CEO's inbox, calendar, and the firm's internal finances.

•
: Own the inbox. Fully handle routine messages, draft replies in the CEO's voice for anything that needs her judgment, and follow up on stalled threads.

• Calendar: Own the CEO's schedule. Book and adjust meetings in real time, protect focused work blocks, and step in on scheduling in WhatsApp and Slack without being tagged.

• Meeting support: Prepare agendas and background for the CEO's key meetings, capture notes and action items, and follow up until every action item is done.

• Firm billing & books: Own the firm's finances end to end. Invoice monthly fees on the 1st, subscription costs on or before the 20th, and completed projects within 1 business day. Run collections, categorize transactions, reconcile payments, update the cash position weekly, and close the firm's books by the 3rd business day for the CEO's final review.

• Subscription & pricing audit: Each month, check every pass-through cost the firm pays on behalf of clients against what clients are billed, and flag any price change the same day with a recommended fee adjustment.

• Weekly Summary Report: Submit a weekly report every Friday covering team KPIs, onboarding status, unpaid clients, project status, decisions you made, and where you need support.

• Taking more off the CEO's plate: Each month, identify at least one task the CEO is still doing that you could take over, and propose a plan to own it.



2. Support the Team:

You own the firm's systems, records, and people processes.

• Team support: Be the team's go-to for admin questions during your shift, respond quickly, and send reminders and prompts so deadlines and to-dos don't slip.

• KPI tracking: Track team task completion and KPIs, and have the data ready for every performance evaluation.

• Systems: Maintain Asana and Double alongside the Client Accounting Manager, and own firm-wide file management in Google Drive.

• HR administration: Keep performance review notes, and send birthday, holiday, and recognition messages.

• Hiring: Run the hiring pipeline when the firm is hiring, from screening applicants to scheduling interviews.

• Team onboarding & offboarding: Set up accounts, tool access, and permissions for new team members, and remove access the day someone leaves.

• SOPs: Create and maintain written and video SOPs for every process you own.



3. Support the Clients:

You own the client journey from first inquiry to kickoff, and from cancellation to close-out.

• Leads: Log every new lead in our CRM, notify the CEO, schedule a discovery call within 24 hours, and run lead nurture so no prospect goes cold.

• Onboarding: Send welcome
s and intake forms, chase missing information, and prepare an intake summary before every kickoff call.

• Offboarding: Send the final invoice, cancel any subscriptions billed through the firm, revoke access, and archive files.

• Communication: Acknowledge client inquiries within 1 business day, and keep contracts, intake forms, and welcome materials current.



Confidentiality

This role has access to the CEO's
, the firm's finances, client financial data, and team HR records. All of it must be handled with complete discretion.



Requirements

• Minimum 2 years of experience as a virtual administrative or executive assistant

• At least 6 months of hands-on QuickBooks Online Invoicing experience

• Experience managing an inbox and calendar for a business owner or executive

• Excellent written and spoken English

• Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive; comfortable making decisions without step-by-step direction

• Comfortable with Google Workspace, Asana, and Slack (CRM experience, especially Go High Level, is a plus)

• Experience at a bookkeeping or accounting firm is a plus

• Available 8am–4pm CST, Monday through Friday

• Reliable internet connection, backup power, and a quiet remote work setup



Success in This Role Looks Like...

• The CEO no longer has to remind, follow up, or check on your work.

• Her inbox shows only what needs her judgment, and her calendar runs itself.

• Billing goes out on time every month, and the firm's books close on schedule with minimal corrections.

• The team gets fast answers and timely reminders, and systems are always current.

• No lead or client falls through the cracks.



Compensation & Growth

• Starting rate: $3.00 USD/hour, full-time.

• Path to Executive Assistant: This role is designed to grow. After your first 90 days, the CEO will review your progress on autonomy, judgment, reliability, initiative, and communication. Once you are consistently operating as the CEO's right hand, the role moves to Executive Assistant, with a corresponding pay increase.



How to Apply

1. Reply to this job post with “RIGHT HAND” in the subject line.

2. In your response, state:

    ◦ how many years of administrative or executive assistant experience you have

    ◦ how familiar you are with QuickBooks Online invoicing

3. Tell us what makes you the best fit for this role.

***Applications that do NOT follow these instructions will be automatically disqualified without opening.

The Purpose of Your Role 



OCD Anxiety Centers is looking for an Events and Communications Coordinator who can plan an event down to the last name tag and write the press release that announces it. Success Indicators/KPIs 



Open Houses & Events: 

- 100% of scheduled Open Houses coordinated and executed with onsite teams on the approved date, beginning with January 2027. 

- Invitations sent 5+ weeks before each event; event plan and run-of-show approved by the CGO 2+ weeks before. 

- Every event set up as a Salesforce campaign; attendance logged within 2 business days; follow-up sent within 48 hours. 

- Minimum of 2 admissions per Open House, attributed through Salesforce within 90 days; referrals and admissions reported monthly. 



PR & Media: 

- 12 press releases per year (one per month), drafted and submitted for approval by the 10th of each month. 

- National, investor, and local media lists built and validated by March 31, 2027. 

- Local media placement for 100% of new location openings; support at least 1 national placement per quarter. 

- Placement log (outlet, date, reach) updated within 2 business days of every placement. 

- Minimum of 6 award, nomination, or speaking submissions per year (e.g., Best of Bountiful). 



Internal Communications: 

- Company announcements drafted within 1 business day of request, for CGO review and approval. 

- Combined events and communications calendar maintained and reviewed with the CGO weekly. 

- Upon achieving these key performance indicators, your supervisor will meet with you to review progress and collaborate on establishing new performance goals that reflect continued growth and excellence. 



Core Competencies (Non-Negotiable) 

- Fluent in spoken and written English. 

- Understanding of American culture, professional norms, and business communication. 

- Previous work experience with a U.S.-based company. 

- Ability to work U.S. hours (Mountain Time), with occasional overtime as needed. 

- Polished written and verbal communication, with the ability to professionally represent OCD Anxiety Centers to providers, media, partners, and other stakeholders through virtual communication. 

- Event planning and logistics across multiple locations, vendors, and timelines. 

- Organized, reliable, and resourceful when plans change, with comfort navigating sensitive mental health topics. 





Core Responsibilities 



Open Houses: Plan and coordinate Open Houses at each location remotely, including invitations, catering arrangements, event materials, run-of-show, and coordination with Outreach and onsite teams responsible for provider relationships, invite lists, and day-of execution. 



Openings and events: Coordinate grand openings and ribbon cuttings for new locations, plus logistics for CE events, conferences (including ADAA and IOCDF), awareness-month and community events, and internal events such as Town Halls, working with U.S.-based teams for onsite support.

Event results: Build each event as a Salesforce campaign, log attendees, coordinate follow-up
 campaigns, arrange for event photos and videos to be captured by onsite teams for social media, and report resulting referrals and admissions. 



Press: Draft monthly press releases for openings, partnerships, and milestones; pitch local media for every opening; submit award nominations and speaking opportunities. 



Media relations: Build national, investor, and local media lists and a PR calendar targeting regional business and healthcare trade press; triage media requests and prepare spokespeople remotely. 



Internal communications: Draft company-wide announcements, leadership messages, and employee updates; distribute internal campaigns to department heads and locations; support a staff brand ambassador program on LinkedIn. 



Payor communications: Support communications with payors in partnership with the Director of Payor Relations. 



Adheres to all company policies and procedures. 



Other duties as assigned. 







The Skills and Expertise You Have 



3+ years in event coordination, communications, marketing, or healthcare operations. 



Experience planning and executing events from start to finish, including budgets, vendors, and day-of logistics. 



Strong writing skills: press releases, newsletters, reports, and executive-level communications.

title: CREATIVE SOCIAL MEDIA VIDEO EDITOR
description:
Short-Form Video | Retail Marketing | Social Media Content

We are looking for a talented, creative, and detail-oriented Social Media Video Editor who can transform raw video footage into engaging, high-quality, attention-grabbing marketing videos for our retail brands.

The raw footage will be provided. Your responsibility will be to take individual clips and turn them into creative, cohesive, professional, and impactful videos that tell a complete story, highlight products, promote sales, and capture the audience's attention.

Our primary focus is short-form social media videos, typically 15–30 seconds, with occasional videos ranging from 30 seconds up to 2 minutes.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Video Editing & Creative Production

 • Review, organize, and select the best footage from the raw video clips provided.

 • Combine multiple clips into one cohesive, creative, and professionally edited video.

 • Create engaging sequences with smooth transitions and well-paced cuts.

 • Remove unnecessary footage, pauses, mistakes, and repetitive scenes.

 • Ensure every video has a clear beginning, middle, and ending.

 • Create videos that communicate the complete message without confusing the viewer.

 • Use creative editing techniques to make videos visually exciting and memorable.

 • Maintain professional quality, consistency, and attention to detail.

2. Attention-Grabbing Content & Storytelling

 • Create powerful openings (hooks) that capture attention within the first 1–3 seconds.

 • Understand how to keep viewers interested and prevent them from scrolling past the video.

 • Use creative sequencing, close-ups, different camera angles, and dynamic cuts.

 • Highlight the most important products, promotions, and selling points.

 • Build excitement and create a sense of urgency for sales, special events, and new arrivals.

 • Make videos visually appealing while keeping the message clear and easy to understand.

 • Understand retail marketing psychology and what motivates customers to shop.

3. Music, Sound & Audio Editing

 • Select appropriate trending or commercially licensed music that complements each video.

 • Synchronize video cuts and transitions with the music beat whenever appropriate.

 • Incorporate sound effects to make videos more engaging.

 • Adjust audio levels to ensure music, voiceovers, and dialogue are balanced.

 • Clean up background noise and improve voice clarity when needed.

 • Incorporate voiceovers, spoken announcements, and recorded audio when provided.

4. Text, Graphics & Visual Effects

 • Add professional, eye-catching text overlays to communicate important information.

 • Incorporate promotional prices, discounts, product names, and special offers.

 • Highlight important calls to action such as "Shop Now," "Visit Us Today," and "Available at All Locations."

 • Use animated text, motion graphics, and visual effects when appropriate.

 • Incorporate logos, brand elements, and promotional graphics.

 • Ensure all text is spelled correctly, easy to read, and displayed long enough for viewers to understand.

 • Maintain a clean, modern, professional look without overusing effects.

5. Social Media Optimization

 • Edit videos primarily in vertical 9:16 format (1080 × 1920) for:

 ◦ Instagram Reels

 ◦
 Reels

 ◦ TikTok

 ◦ YouTube Shorts

 • Ensure videos are properly framed for mobile viewing.

 • Keep important text and products within social media safe zones.

 • Create alternative formats when requested (square or horizontal).

 • Understand platform-specific video trends, formats, and audience behavior.

 • Optimize video pacing, length, and presentation for social media engagement.

6. Retail & Product Marketing

 • Create compelling product showcase videos that make products look desirable.

 • Highlight product details through close-ups, slow motion, and creative camera sequences.

 • Create promotional videos for sales, holidays, special events, and store openings.

 • Showcase new arrivals, best sellers, exclusive products, and special collections.

 • Make pricing, discounts, and promotional details easy to understand.

 • Create excitement around retail campaigns and limited-time offers.

 • Understand the importance of presenting products in a way that encourages customers to visit our stores and make purchases.

7. Branding & Consistency

 • Follow brand guidelines, including logos, colors, fonts, and overall visual identity.

 • Maintain a consistent look and feel across all social media content.

 • Ensure each brand's personality and target audience are reflected in the final videos.

 • Properly incorporate brand logos and closing screens when needed.

8. Quality Control & Final Delivery

 • Review every video before submitting the final version.

 • Check spelling, pricing, promotional details, audio, transitions, and video quality.

 • Ensure there are no awkward cuts, black frames, missing clips, or unfinished sequences.

 • Deliver polished, ready-to-publish videos in high resolution.

 • Keep project files and organized footage when requested.

 • Make revisions and adjustments based on feedback.

 • Meet agreed deadlines and maintain consistent production turnaround times.

REQUIRED SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS

 • Proven experience editing short-form social media videos.

 • Strong creative vision and understanding of social media content.

 • Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, or similar editing software.

 • Strong understanding of Instagram Reels,
 Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.

 • Knowledge of transitions, motion graphics, typography, sound design, and color correction.

 • Ability to turn basic raw footage into creative, professional marketing content.

 • Excellent attention to detail and strong organizational skills.

 • Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.

 • Strong understanding of retail advertising and promotional content is a plus.

 • A portfolio or examples of previously edited social media videos is required.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for someone who is more than just an editor. We need a creative individual who understands how to make people STOP SCROLLING, WATCH, and TAKE ACTION.

Someone who:

 • Has a strong sense of creativity and knows what makes a video stand out.

 • Understands current social media trends and knows how to incorporate them appropriately.

 • Can take ordinary footage and turn it into extraordinary content.

 • Knows how to make products look attractive and promotions exciting.

 • Understands that the first few seconds of a video are critical.

 • Has an eye for detail and takes pride in delivering exceptional work.

 • Can consistently produce fresh ideas and creative approaches.

VIDEO LENGTH: Primarily 15–30 seconds, with occasional videos up to 2 minutes.

FOOTAGE: Raw video clips will be provided. The editor is responsible for selecting, organizing, editing, and producing the complete final video.

APPLICATION REQUIREMENT: Applicants must submit a portfolio or links to previously edited short-form social media videos.

Our goal: Create content that doesn't just look good. It gets attention, creates excitement, and brings customers through our doors.

title: Orthodontic Virtual Assistant (Remote -  $7 to $8 per hour)
description:
Dental office or practice experience required



Orthodontic Virtual Assistant. For someone whose voice makes a nervous parent smile before they ever walk through our door.



Our best days start with good music playing low and a phone that keeps ringing in the best way. Every caller

hears someone who sounds genuinely glad they called. By the end of the day, people who dialed in unsure have

a first visit on the calendar and are already looking forward to it. Nobody is rushing. Nobody sounds like they're

reading a script. Dr. B and the team are in sync, and the day moves like a great set: everyone knows their part,

and the whole room sounds better because of it. You'll be working virtually, but you are still part of that room.



We are small by choice. That means you will know our patients and families by name, they will know your voice,

and the people you work with will notice when you do something great and say so out loud. We're a brand new

practice in Green Hills, Nashville, and you will be one of the very first voices people hear. We're building

something we are really proud of, one great phone call at a time!



Everything we do runs on five values we call MAGIC: Mastery, Authenticity, Growth, Integrity, and Compassion.



They aren't a poster on the wall. They're how we show up for our patients and for each other, and they're what

we look for in every person who joins us.



Who thrives here

You're someone who lives our five values without being told, and who lights up when the phone rings:



Mastery. You take pride in a clean, well run schedule and a perfectly confirmed appointment, and you would

rather ask "why do we do it this way?" than guess. New software and a really good system give you a little

thrill, and insurance language sounds like something you'd enjoy learning, not something to fear.



Authenticity. You're the same warm, upbeat person on a call as you are with your best friend. Your energy

is natural, not performed. You can make a worried parent and a shy teenager both feel like the most

interesting caller of the day, and you tell the truth kindly, whether that's "that time is taken, but here's a great

option" or "here's what I'd do differently."



Growth. You're curious, you welcome change, and you hear "small team" and think "my ideas will be

heard," not "that sounds like a lot."



Integrity. You do the right thing when no one is watching. When you promise a callback, you call back. You

show up on time and ready because the first caller of the day is counting on you, and when you make a

mistake you say so and fix it.



Compassion. You can hear the worry in someone's voice and slow down before anyone asks you to. You

listen first, because every patient and family calls with different needs and different questions.

Your phone presence is the job. A caller meets us through your voice, and a warm, upbeat, confident

one is the best first impression we could ask for. If you light up on a call, we want to meet you.



Dental experience is required, and orthodontic experience is a bonus. Phone based customer service

experience helps too. Insurance experience is not required, because we will train you. Energy and heart are the

things we can't teach, and everything else we can. If you have both, we want to hear from you!



What you'll do

This role is more than scheduling. Here is what your days cover, and we will train you on the insurance side.

3. Partner with the CEO to advance growth goals through the team. Translate the CEO's priorities into clear assignments for each Growth Team member. Maintain a written weekly update to the CEO covering results against targets, decisions needed, and risks, so that the CEO's limited availability never becomes a bottleneck.

4. Lead and develop direct reports. Provide direction, coaching, and accountability to the Strategic Support Specialist and the Digital Engagement Specialist. Hold regular one-on-ones, set clear weekly priorities, review work product, and run the weekly Growth Team meeting.

5. Oversight and coordination of agency, community personnel, vendors, and partners. Serve as the primary point of coordination for the Marketing Agency, the Graphic Designer, the Community Engagement Specialist, and outside vendors and partners. Align timing, audiences, and messaging so that in-house and outside work do not overlap or conflict. Confirm deliverables, deadlines, and brand standards.

6. Brand safety and compliance first-pass screen. Review all outbound content before it posts for health claims, testimonials, and regulated language. Escalate anything uncertain to the Chief Legal Officer before publication. 

7. Review and listing monitoring. Monitor app store reviews, Google Business listings, and social mentions. Respond in TRIUNE's brand voice where appropriate, and escalate product, service, or legal concerns to the right owner.

Secondary Responsibilities

These responsibilities support the primary duties above. The Growth Manager owns them directly where the team lacks a specialist, and otherwise coordinates the people or vendors who carry them.

1. Ring revenue scorecard. Monitor the TRIUNE scorecard of Ring units sold and app subscriptions by channel 
, organic social, paid, community, partners) and present it to the CEO.

2. Paid advertising. Coordinate Google and Meta campaigns run by the Marketing Agency or a paid media resource: support approval of budgets and creative, confirm audience and timing, and review cost per subscription and return on spend. Direct hands-on campaign management is not expected but is welcome.

3. Conversion path. Work with the website developer and the Ring ordering vendor to reduce friction in the product page, checkout, and app onboarding. Track drop-off at each step and recommend fixes.

4. Retention and churn. Track subscription cancellations, run renewal and win-back
 campaigns, and flag product issues that drive churn to the technical team.

5. Promotions and offers. Plan launch promotions, bundles, and referral offers. Oversee promo code tracking and attribution handled by the Digital Engagement Specialist.

6. Content and creative pipeline. Own the content calendar across
, social, short-form video, and the Chronicles storytelling program. Brief the Graphic Designer and agency, and approve creative before it posts.

7. Launch and event support (remote). Serve as the remote growth lead for TRIUNE launches and community events: pre-event registration campaigns,
 and social promotion, capture of attendee contact information through on-site personnel, and post-event conversion follow-up. In-person attendance is not required.

8. Partner and community channels. Support outreach to senior living communities, YMCAs, run clubs, clinics, and similar partners by supplying campaign materials, co-branded content, and follow-up sequences, working through the Community Engagement Specialist for in-person activity.

9. Analytics and attribution. Keep a single source of truth for growth metrics across the
 platform, Shopify, app stores, Google Analytics, and ad accounts. Enforce UTM discipline and report customer acquisition cost and conversion rates.

10. Search and app store optimization. Oversee keywords, listing copy, screenshots, and review velocity for the TRIUNE app and website.

11. Customer voice loop. Deliver a monthly summary of reviews, support themes, and social feedback to the CEO and technical team with recommended messaging or product changes.

12. Marketing tools and vendor budgets. Administer the marketing tool stack and vendor relationships 
 platform, Shopify apps, creator content, agency statements of work) and track spend against budget.

13. Testing program. Run a standing test program on
 subject lines, landing pages, offers, and creative, and document what was learned.

Working Remotely With the Team

• Run a standing weekly Growth Team meeting and hold individual one-on-ones with each direct report (Mondays at 5pm CST.) 

• Keep the team's shared trackers (content calendar, production tracker, campaign tracker, RAID tracker) current so status is visible without a meeting.

• Send the CEO a concise written weekly update; reserve live time with the CEO for decisions, not status.

Qualifications

• Four or more years in digital marketing, growth, or lifecycle marketing, including at least one year leading people or a small team.

• Hands-on experience running
 marketing programs: segmentation, automation, testing, and reporting.

• Working familiarity with Google and Meta advertising, Shopify, Google Analytics, and app store listings. Direct paid media management experience is a plus, not a requirement.

 campaign calendar running on schedule with documented performance.

We are looking for a highly efficient Operations Manager to serve as the operational backbone of our growing organization.
