title: Director, Global Alliances – Accenture
OPERATIONS MANAGER (Real Estate Exp is a MUST)
description:
About the Role





We are looking for a highly efficient Operations Manager to serve as the operational backbone of our growing organization. Because we rely heavily on AI to multiply our output, this is not a traditional middle-management position—we need a generalist leader with broad operational capability who can build systems, execute AI-driven projects, organize complex data, and lead a team of Virtual Assistants (VAs).



You will own the mechanics of how our business runs: from architecting our lead funnel and customer-touch processes to troubleshooting daily bottlenecks and coaching our team for maximum efficiency.



Key Responsibilities



AI Leverage & Project Execution: Identify high-impact opportunities to integrate AI tools and automation into daily workflows. Take AI initiatives from concept to full operational deployment, ensuring tools actually save time and improve output quality.



Funnel & Customer-Touch Architecture: Build, optimize, and maintain our end-to-end lead funnel. Design and document seamless customer-touch processes—from initial inquiry through onboarding and ongoing client communication—so nothing falls through the cracks.



VA Team Leadership & Coaching: Directly manage, mentor, and coach a team of Virtual Assistants. Drive coaching efficiency by creating clear SOPs, running tight feedback loops, and holding team members accountable to clear performance metrics.



Systems, Data & Operational Fixes: Maintain clean, structured, and accessible company data across our tech stack. Act as the primary problem-solver for operational breakdowns—stepping in to execute quick fixes while designing permanent system improvements to prevent repeat issues.



Qualifications



Proven Operational Range: Demonstrated experience in an Operations Manager, Chief of Staff, or senior integrator role where you wore multiple hats across systems, marketing operations, and client delivery.



High AI Fluency: Hands-on experience using modern AI tools (LLMs, workflow automation platforms like Zapier/Make, AI-assisted data tools) to streamline business operations—not just surface-level prompting.



Funnel & CRM Experience: Practical background building or managing lead pipelines, CRM workflows, and multi-channel customer touchpoints.



Remote Team Leadership: Track record of successfully managing and upskilling remote teams or Virtual Assistants, with a sharp eye for workflow efficiency and clear delegation.



Data & Systems Mindset: Strong organizational skills with the ability to audit messy processes, clean up databases, and build scalable, repeatable workflows.









Please include "Leverage Agent - Operations Manager" in the subject line.

title: OPERATIONS MANAGER (Real Estate Experience is a MUST)
description:
We are seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented Operations Manager to oversee the daily execution of our residential real estate transactions, marketing outreach campaigns, and internal database operations. Acting as the central operational hub for our team, you will bridge the gap between active client escrows and business growth initiatives—ensuring seamless closings, accurate brand assets, and high-performing outreach workflows.







Key Responsibilities

1. Transaction & Escrow Management

Closing & Title Coordination: Confirm final closing and recording statuses directly with title companies; coordinate payment methods and check-pickup logistics.



Inspection & Repair Negotiations: Track and follow up on seller responses to the BINSR (Buyer’s Inspection Notice and Seller’s Response).



Vendor & Municipal Compliance: Collect contractor estimates, verify municipal permit statuses (such as patio and structural permits), and liaise with specialty vendors (e.g., roofing contractors) to gather formal assessments.



Client Decision Support: Present vendor recommendations and repair estimates to clients and lead agents to secure timely decisions on negotiation next steps.



2. Growth, Marketing & Outreach Operations

Campaign Review & Alignment: Manage feedback loops with leadership on growth workbooks, neighborhood market reports, SMS/text drafts, and call priority lists.



Technical QA & Testing: Execute end-to-end phone and message delivery testing prior to launching outreach campaigns.



Performance & Priority Management: Establish baseline metrics for outreach campaigns and finalize call/text priorities following leadership review.



3. Brand Asset & Database Quality Control

Directory & Profile Audits: Regularly review flagged agent/team profiles in internal tracking systems (e.g., B•Real tracker) to identify discrepancies or outdated assets.



Asset Replacement Coordination: Manage the end-to-end replacement of outdated profile images and branding materials with creative vendors or team members.



System Maintenance: Maintain accurate, real-time status logs across operational trackers as updates and corrections are completed.



Qualifications & Skills

Experience: 2+ years in real estate operations, transaction coordination, or executive administration (experience with Arizona residential real estate contracts and BINSR workflows strongly preferred).



Technical Proficiency: Strong command of spreadsheets/workbooks (Excel/Google Sheets), CRM platforms, SMS/dialer testing tools, and project tracking databases.



Communication: Clear, proactive communicator capable of coordinating directly with title officers, contractors, clients, and internal leadership.



Execution Style: Self-directed problem solver who thrives in fast-paced environments, manages competing deadlines without dropping details, and takes full ownership of follow-through.



Please include "Leverage Agent - Operations Manager" at the subject line.

title: HR & Recruiting Coordinator (Early Intervention)
description:
Job title: HR & Recruiting Coordinator (Early Intervention)

Starting pay: ₱45,000 per month

Schedule: Full-time | U.S. Eastern business hours

Location: Work from home | Philippines-based applicants only

Minimum experience: 2 years in HR or recruiting coordination, including at least 1 year personally handling both candidate follow-up and onboarding or personnel file review



We’re hiring a full-time HR & Recruiting Coordinator to support a New York-based Early Intervention agency that provides evaluations and therapy services to young children. You’ll screen candidates, coordinate interviews, and review onboarding and personnel files. We’re looking for someone who builds rapport over the phone, notices when details don’t match, and takes ownership of getting them corrected.



What you’ll do

- Review applications, conduct initial phone or video screenings, schedule interviews, and follow up with candidates.

- Keep the recruiting tracker current so the hiring team can see each candidate’s status, next step, and follow-up date.

- Review onboarding and personnel files for accuracy. Cross-check names, dates of birth, addresses, and contact details across forms and system records.

- Identify missing documents, signatures, or conflicting information. Explain what needs to be corrected, follow up respectfully, and verify the correction before marking the file complete.

- Keep the team informed when a deadline is at risk and suggest ways to prevent recurring paperwork issues.

What you’ll bring

- At least 2 years of HR or recruiting coordination experience, including 1 year handling both candidate follow-up and file review.

- Hands-on experience screening candidates and using an applicant tracking system (ATS), recruiting CRM, or structured hiring tracker.

- Experience maintaining personnel records in an HR system, onboarding platform, or shared document tracker. Working knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets is required.

- Strong spoken and written English, sound judgment with confidential information, and confidence following up by phone and
.

Preferred experience

title: Construction Project Management Virtual Assistant
description:
Remote · Minimum 15 hours per week · Available every weekday during Pacific Time business hours



We’re Bespoke Design + Build, a design-build firm based in Coeur d’Alene, Idaho. We’re hiring an experienced construction project management virtual assistant to coordinate preconstruction for our custom homes, additions, and remodels. You’ll work with our design team, field staff, county and city planners, permit reviewers, engineers, and suppliers so our project managers have what they need before work begins.



What you’ll do

- Coordinate site plans and field information. Arrange for our on-site team to gather measurements, photos, and existing-condition details. Get that information to the person preparing the site plan and track it through completion.

- Move drawings and engineering through review. Coordinate floor plans, finish plans, selections, and engineering with the people responsible. Track open questions, follow up on revisions, and make sure everyone is working from the current drawings.

- Work directly with planners and permitting offices. Contact the appropriate county or city office early to confirm application requirements, required site information, and review steps. Coordinate documents and submissions, track permit status, route reviewer comments to the right team member, and follow corrections through approval.

- Coordinate materials with our selections team and suppliers. Confirm approved specifications, availability, lead times, and order deadlines. Track order status and expected deliveries against the construction schedule. If a material will arrive too late, flag it while the team still has time to respond.

- Keep our project managers informed before construction. Update the assigned PM throughout preconstruction and prepare a handoff before mobilization. Walk the PM through the current plan set, permit approvals and outstanding inspections or conditions, material orders, expected deliveries, and any open items. Each open item should have a person responsible and a due date.

- Keep Houzz Pro and other software current. Maintain drawings, decisions, deadlines, and project status so our team can see what’s ready, what’s waiting, and who needs to act next.



What we require

- Previous construction project management experience. You’ve personally coordinated drawings, people, and deadlines on construction projects and can describe the work you owned.

- Fluency in spoken and written English. You’re comfortable calling a county planner, clarifying a supplier’s lead time, and giving a project manager a concise update.

- Consistent availability Monday through Friday during our office hours of 8 a.m.–5 p.m. Pacific Time, with a minimum commitment of 15 hours per week.

- Ability to read construction drawings, manage several projects at once, and follow up independently.

Drafting experience is a plus. Experience with residential preconstruction, U.S. permitting offices, or Houzz Pro is also valuable.



To apply



Send your résumé, hourly rate, and the specific hours you can work each weekday in Pacific Time. Include one brief example of a project you helped move from design or permitting into construction. Tell us what you personally coordinated, one issue you resolved before the crew started, and what information you handed to the project manager. If you have drafting experience, include the software you use and the types of plans you’ve prepared.

title: Part-Time Senior React / TypeScript Developer — US Vehicle-Repair Platform (Long-Term, Remote)
description:
About the work. Wrenchli is a live US platform that helps car owners understand a repair problem, see a fair published price range, and get referred to a vetted repair shop. You would be the dedicated developer for the public website and its tools: small fixes, content and data updates, prepared feature changes, and first response when something breaks. The site is one codebase: React + TypeScript, Supabase (Postgres, auth, edge functions), deployed on Vercel, source on GitHub.



Schedule. 20 hours per week to start, Philippine daytime hours. You work while the US team sleeps. Every workday ends with a short written handoff (what changed, what is blocked, what is next). This role can grow to full-time based on results.



Pay. $1,380/month flat retainer, paid monthly, 13th month prorated and included in the figure above (the retainer is the whole pay, no surprises). Paid through a contractor platform (contract, tax forms, and payment handled there). A paid trial task (fixed $200) comes before any offer.



How we work (read carefully).

- All changes go through GitHub pull requests. Nothing deploys directly to production; every change is reviewed and gated before it ships.

- Access is staged: you start with the codebase and staging, and production access grows only on evidence.

- Written English matters more than spoken. The handoff note is the job's heartbeat.

- We use AI coding tools heavily. You are expected to use them well and to check their work like a senior.



Must have.

- 4+ years with React and TypeScript in production, with at least one live product you can link to.

- Real Supabase experience (Postgres, row-level security, edge functions) or very strong Postgres + serverless experience and a fast ramp.

- Comfort with Vercel deployments and GitHub pull-request workflow.

- A GitHub profile or portfolio that shows your own code.



To apply, answer all three (applications without answers are not read):

1. Link to one production React + TypeScript project you built or substantially maintained, and say in 3-4 sentences what was hardest about it.

2. Describe a time you used Supabase row-level security (or Postgres policies) to protect data. What was the rule, and how did you test it?

3. Write the end-of-day handoff note you would leave for the founder after a day where you fixed a broken page, found a second problem you could not fix yet, and finished a small feature. (This is a writing sample, not a trick.)

title: Bilingual Spanish/English Legal Intake Specialist & Legal Assistant (US Law Firm)
description:
ABOUT US

Gaines & Gaines, APLC is a California law firm that stands up for employees in workplace disputes, including unpaid wages, wrongful termination, discrimination, and retaliation. We're a small, close-knit team made up of our attorney, our in-office staff, and several remote virtual assistants who are a valued part of our day-to-day operations. Many of the people who contact us speak Spanish, and we're looking for a bilingual team member to be the first friendly, professional voice they hear.



WHY JOIN US

• Long-term position: we're looking for someone to grow with us, not a short-term hire

• Extensive training: we'll teach you our intake process, legal terminology, our systems, and exactly what to ask and say. No prior legal experience is required, but is preferred.

• Ongoing support: you'll never be left on your own. Our team is available to answer questions, review your work, and help you improve.

• A close-knit, supportive team: you'll work alongside other remote VAs who know what it's like to work US hours from the Philippines, and you'll be treated as a real member of the firm

• Meaningful work: you'll help workers who have been treated unfairly get the help they need

• Room to grow: as you learn, you can take on more responsibility in intake and legal assistant work



THE ROLE

You'll handle intake calls with Spanish- and English-speaking potential new clients, gather the facts of their situation, write clear summaries in English for our attorney, and support our legal team with client communication and admin work.



RESPONSIBILITIES

• Make and answer calls with potential new clients in Spanish and English using our firm phone system

• Conduct intake interviews using our screening questions, and write clear, organized English summaries

• Schedule intake calls and follow-ups, and keep records updated in our case management system

• Request and organize client documents (paystubs, timecards, termination letters, etc.)

• Translate
s, texts, and documents between Spanish and English

• Monitor shared inboxes and respond promptly

• Assist with general legal assistant tasks such as client updates, data entry, and document prep



Note: You will not give legal advice. You'll be fully trained on our process and what to say.



REQUIREMENTS

• Fluent Spanish AND English, both spoken and written (you will be tested in both)

• Strong phone presence: patient, warm, and able to keep callers on topic when they're stressed or confused

• Excellent written English, with clear, accurate, concise notes

• Experience in intake, a call center, customer service, or virtual assistant work for US clients

• Strong attention to detail and the ability to keep client information strictly confidential

• Reliable high-speed internet, backup internet/power, a quiet workspace, and a noise-canceling headset

• Available during US Pacific Time business hours



NICE TO HAVE

• Experience at a US law firm, especially in employment, personal injury, or other intake-heavy practices

• Experience with Clio, Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel), and OneDrive. We use these every day, so experience is a plus, but not required. We'll train you!

• Familiarity with 8x8 (or a similar VoIP phone system) and Calendly

• Comfort with Mexican and Central American Spanish dialects and slang



SCHEDULE & PAY

• Full-time, Monday through Friday

• Typical hours: 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM Pacific Time (about 12:30 AM to 9:00 AM Manila time)

• Two paid 10-minute breaks and one unpaid 30-minute lunch each day

• After you complete training, we're open to a longer unpaid lunch (up to 1 hour) if you prefer

• Pay: $5 to $10/hour, depending on experience

• Long-term role for the right person



HOW TO APPLY

To be considered, please:

• Use the subject line "Bilingual Interview – [Your Full Name]"

• Attach your resume

• Include a short voice recording (2 to 3 minutes): introduce yourself in English, then pretend you're answering a call from a Spanish-speaking worker who says they weren't paid for overtime. Greet them and ask your first few questions in Spanish.

• Briefly tell us where and how you learned Spanish, and describe any intake or legal experience



Applications that don't follow these instructions won't be reviewed.

title: Affiliate Marketing & Online Sales Partner – Telehealth (Commission Only)
description:
ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

We are looking for motivated, entrepreneurial individuals who know how to generate online traffic, build interest in health and wellness services, and convert that interest into qualified customers.

Learn more:







COMPENSATION



This is a performance-based affiliate marketing opportunity.



Under the proposed compensation structure, affiliates earn a 15% commission on qualifying first purchases generated through their unique tracking link.



For illustration, qualifying purchases of $250 would generate:



- 1 sale: $37.50 USD

- 5 sales: $187.50 USD

- 10 sales: $375 USD

- 20 sales: $750 USD

- 50 sales: $1,875 USD

All sales attribution will be managed through our affiliate tracking platform.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

 groups and relevant online communities

- Developing relevant referral traffic sources

- Identifying underserved audiences interested in personalized wellness

- Testing new, ethical organic marketing strategies



We are open to creative approaches and want partners who can identify opportunities independently.



All marketing must comply with applicable platform rules, advertising requirements, and our approved medical messaging guidelines. Affiliates must clearly disclose their relationship with PPH, avoid unsolicited spam, and must not make unsupported treatment claims, offer personalized medical advice, or guarantee treatment eligibility.



Unauthorized paid advertising is not permitted.



WHAT WE PROVIDE



- A unique, trackable affiliate link

- Information about our platform and services

- AI support

- Guidance on compliant messaging

- Affiliate tracking and performance reporting



You do not need to provide medical consultations, process payments, prescribe treatments, or manage customer fulfillment.



Licensed medical professionals handle clinical decisions.



Your focus is generating legitimate interest and qualified website traffic.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 communities, Reddit, Quora, or similar platforms

Previous experience with affiliate marketing in the health and wellness industry is desirable.



Medical expertise is not required.



HOW TO APPLY

 groups, Reddit, Quora, or other online communities.

title: Cold Caller
description:
We're looking for a **Cold Caller** to own outbound phone-based outreach for a newly founded private equity firm actively sourcing acquisition targets across IT managed services, marketing agencies, BPO, accounting and finance, logistics, SaaS, software development, and recruiting. You will make a high volume of outbound calls to business owners and company leaders to identify potential acquisition interest, qualify conversations, and book meetings for the deal team.



This is a pure cold calling role. You will be dialing business owners and operators all day, opening conversations from cold, and moving qualified interest forward to the next step. The work is repetitive, the rejection rate is high, and results come from consistent volume and a professional, confident phone manner. If you are resilient, disciplined, and motivated by a clear and measurable output, this role is a strong fit.



## Why You'll Want to Join



- You will be paid in **USD** (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)

- **Paid Time Off** in accordance with company policy

- Observance of **Holidays** per company guidelines

- **100% remote setup** so you can work wherever you're most productive

- This role requires availability during **US business hours**

- Work at the front end of the deal pipeline for a newly founded private equity firm with an active acquisitions thesis

- High-activity role with clear metrics and direct impact on deal flow



## What You'll Work On



**High-Volume Outbound Cold Calling**



- Make high-volume outbound calls to business owners and company leaders across target verticals daily

- Open cold conversations professionally and pivot quickly to qualify acquisition interest

- Handle objections confidently and keep conversations moving toward a booked meeting or callback

- Maintain a consistent, high call volume throughout the full working day without losing energy or quality



**Lead Qualification and Pipeline Management**



- Qualify prospects based on defined criteria including business type, revenue range, ownership structure, and interest level

- Log all call activity, outcomes, and notes accurately in the CRM after every interaction

- Book qualified meetings for the deal team with full context and qualification notes

- Follow up on warm contacts and callbacks consistently



**Reporting and Communication**



- Meet daily and weekly call volume targets consistently

- Report on call activity, connect rates, and meetings booked regularly

- Flag patterns in objections or prospect feedback that could improve targeting or messaging



## What You Bring



- Prior cold calling experience with a track record of booking meetings or qualified conversations from cold outreach

- Confident, clear, and professional phone presence with the ability to engage a business owner or executive from a cold call

- Comfortable with high rejection rates and able to reset quickly between calls without losing momentum

- Fluent, professional spoken English; this is a phone-first role and your voice is the product

- Organized with clean CRM habits and accurate call logging

- Reliable, self-directed, and disciplined with the ability to hit daily activity targets independently

- Quiet, professional calling environment and reliable high-speed internet



## Nice to Have



- Experience cold calling in a B2B context including business owners, executives, or operators

- Background in deal sourcing, business development, or financial services outreach

- Familiarity with the verticals being targeted including IT services, marketing agencies, BPO, accounting, logistics, SaaS, or recruiting



## How to Apply



Please include:



1. Your **updated resume**

2. A **short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes)** introducing yourself, describing your cold calling experience, and giving an example of how you handle a business owner who immediately says they are not interested in selling



**Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.**



If you are resilient, disciplined, and comfortable making a high volume of cold calls to business owners every day, this role gives you the volume, the mission, and the direct impact to do your best work.

title: Operations Assistant VA
description:
Keep Every Order Moving, From Vendor to Warehouse



WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS



Before a lab can order from Filtrous, the product has to be on our shelves, and that starts with a purchase order placed well in advance. When that order goes out late, a vendor falls behind, or a shipment arrives wrong, our stock runs low and customers wait. As our Operations Assistant VA, you'll own the purchasing and vendor pipeline end-to-end, from the reorder sheet to the warehouse door. You'll make sure purchase orders go out on time, vendors stay on schedule, and shipments don't fall apart. In a business built on speed and reliability, your work keeps products in stock and our customers' labs running.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



• Turn the Reorder Sheet into Purchase Orders: Work from our reorder sheet to figure out what we need, build purchase orders in our ERP system with the purchasing team, and route them to leadership for approval.



• Source Product with Vendors: Find supplier options, request and compare quotes, and work through product specs and minimum order quantities before an order is placed.



• Confirm Every Order Detail: Send purchase orders to vendors, get the proforma invoice back, and work out adjustments like carton quantities and price changes. Verify barcodes with our operations team before anything is confirmed, and send vendors the full item package: photos, Certificate of Analysis (CoA), and packing list.



• Keep Payments and Production on Track: Send vendor invoices to our finance team for payment, share proof of payment with the vendor, and get a production timeline back. Follow up with every vendor at least weekly, every three days if they go quiet, and escalate if they stop responding. WeChat must be used during business hours for faster turnaround on vendor communication.



• Coordinate Shipping, Tariffs, and Customs: Work with our logistics team and freight partners on shipping and tariffs, consolidating across open purchase orders so we never ship a partial container. Handle customs declarations, declared values, and product classifications using information provided or approved by the company.



• Keep the Warehouse Ready for Every Delivery: Update our ERP system as soon as a delivery date is set and share it with the warehouse right away, then send reminders a week out, three days out, and the morning of delivery.



• Fix Problems and Track Every Order: If a shipment arrives incorrect or damaged, contact the vendor promptly and arrange a timely re-shipment at the vendor's cost. Keep a tracking sheet with each PO number, its exact status, and dates for everything, and other duties as assigned.



PROBLEMS YOU WILL SOLVE



• Purchase orders go out late: Without one person working the reorder sheet and pushing orders through approval, purchase orders slip and stock runs low before replacements are on the way.



• Vendors drift off schedule: When no one follows up on a steady rhythm, suppliers go quiet, production timelines slide, and delays surface only when it is too late to recover.



• Order details slip through the cracks: When carton quantities, price changes, barcodes, and product documents are not checked before an order is confirmed, small mistakes turn into wrong labels, wrong quantities, and costly rework.



• Shipping costs more than it should: Partial containers, orders that are not consolidated, and incomplete customs paperwork add freight costs, tariff surprises, and delays at the border.



• Deliveries catch the warehouse off guard: Without accurate delivery dates and timely reminders, shipments show up unannounced, receiving gets rushed, and damaged or incorrect goods are not sent back to the vendor in time.



HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED



• Get purchase orders built, approved, and sent to vendors on time, every month

• Follow up on every open order at least weekly, with a confirmed production timeline

• Ship zero partial containers by consolidating open orders on every shipment

• Keep the tracking sheet and ERP current, and give the warehouse notice before every delivery



WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT HERE



At Filtrous, you won't be a back-office clerk pushing paperwork. You'll own a pipeline that keeps real laboratories stocked with the supplies they rely on every day. You'll work in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where your ideas for faster, smoother purchasing actually get implemented. You'll collaborate closely with our purchasing, finance, logistics, and warehouse teams, and your impact on on-time orders and in-stock products will be visible and celebrated. As we grow, so will your career, with opportunities to shape how Filtrous buys and ships from the ground up.



WHO YOU ARE



• Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Operations, or a related field (required)

• Experience in purchasing, procurement, or supply chain coordination, working directly with vendors (required)

• Proficient with ERP and inventory systems (e.g., Acumatica, NetSuite, SAP) and spreadsheets (Excel or Google Sheets)

• Comfortable with international shipping basics: freight, tariffs, customs declarations, and product classifications

• Strong written English and the persistence to keep vendors responsive across time zones

• Highly organized with a process-driven mindset and commitment to follow-through



Bonus points if you have:

• Background in the life sciences, biotechnology, or laboratory supplies industry

• Experience importing from overseas suppliers, including container consolidation and vendor communication on WeChat



ABOUT FILTROUS



Founded in 2017, Filtrous delivers speed, quality, and value to agile labs. We're a lab supplies distributor serving laboratories across a wide range of scientific and industrial sectors. Our secret? We combine uncompromising product quality with customer service that actually picks up the phone.



POSITION DETAILS



Compensation: $4.00 – $6.00 USD per hour

Job Type: Part-time (20 hours per week)

Location: Remote

Schedule: Monday to Friday, 3:00–7:00 PM Pacific Time (7:00–11:00 AM Philippine Time, Tuesday to Saturday)



READY TO JOIN US?



If you love keeping complex orders on track, thrive in a fast-moving environment, and want to help shape how a growing company buys and ships, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Video Editor
description:
Hi there! We're Mitch and Hope, a husband-and-wife creative team based in Nashville, Tennessee, USA. We're both video professionals, entrepreneurs and content creators, and we're looking for a long-term video editor to join our small team.



ABOUT US

We create content for two brands of our own:



- Lifestyle and Entertainment: a female-led brand about lifestyle, music, beauty, fashion, travel and life in the Nashville music industry.

- Faith and Culture: a male-led Christian media brand exploring faith, culture and personal growth through podcasts, video essays, commentary and experiential storytelling.



We also do client work similar to our own: social media videos for businesses and creators, and podcast editing for the people who record in our studio.



THE JOB

We're looking for a storyteller, not just someone who knows editing software. You'll take raw footage and turn it into videos that are entertaining, meaningful and keep people watching. You'll work directly with both of us. We'll give you footage, direction, references and feedback, and we also want you to bring your own ideas.



WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON EACH MONTH

Our brands:

- 4 lifestyle YouTube videos (10 to 20 minutes each) plus about 12 short-form clips

- 2 multi-camera podcast episodes (60 to 90 minutes each)

- 2 video essays or reaction videos (15 to 20 minutes each)

- 1 vlog or documentary-style video (up to about 60 minutes)

- Short-form clips cut from all of the above



Client work:

- Social media videos (Reels, TikToks, Shorts) for businesses and creators

- Podcast editing for studio clients



YOUR MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Edit long-form YouTube videos, podcasts and client projects from raw footage to final export

2. Find the best moments in long videos and turn them into short-form clips with strong hooks and captions

3. Handle color correction, audio cleanup, music, sound effects and basic motion graphics

4. Follow each brand's or client's style and deliver on time

5. Keep footage and project files organized, and send us a short daily report of what you worked on, what's finished, and what's next



REQUIRED SKILLS

- Fluent written and spoken English, including conversational English, humor and slang

- Experience editing long-form YouTube content and short-form social videos

- Adobe Premiere Pro

- Multi-camera podcast editing

- A computer that handles 4K footage and a reliable, fast internet connection



WHAT MATTERS TO US

- Strong storytelling instincts and attention to detail

- Reliable and consistent, with clear communication

- Able to work independently and take feedback well

- Comfortable working with Christian and faith-based content

- Willing to keep client footage confidential



NICE TO HAVE

- After Effects or advanced motion graphics

- Experience with influencers, personal brands or agency clients

- 
, LOG footage and proxy workflows

- Knowledge of music and stock footage licensing



SCHEDULE

Full-time, 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday. Hours are mostly flexible. We'd like about 2 hours each weekday that overlap with our US Central business hours for calls and feedback. We'll agree on a time that works for you, such as early morning or late evening Philippine time.



PAY

Monthly salary based on experience and portfolio. The editing test is paid.



GROWING WITH US

We're a small team and we want someone for the long run. As our client work grows, there's room for more creative ownership and raises.



HOW TO APPLY

Please put "Storytelling First" in your subject line and include:

1. A short introduction about you and your editing experience

2. 3 to 5 videos you personally edited (full-length videos, not just a demo reel)

3. Your role in each video

4. Your favorite YouTube creators and what you like about their editing

5. A screenshot of your computer specs (CPU, GPU, RAM) and your available storage

6. A Speedtest.net screenshot showing your internet download and upload speed

7. Your expected monthly salary in USD

8. Your earliest start date

9. Please use 6 apply points to apply



Shortlisted applicants will have a short interview and a paid editing test using footage from our brands and a client project.



Have questions about the role? Ask us in your message. We'd love to hear from you!

title: Estimating & Sales Operations Assistant
description:
Position Summary



Redd Ash Technologies is seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Estimating & Sales Operations Assistant to support our Sales Department with sales administration, estimating, quoting, and proposal coordination.



This is a sales-focused administrative role requiring prior experience supporting a sales team, managing customer quotes, preparing pricing documentation, or coordinating sales opportunities. The ideal candidate understands the administrative processes behind a successful sales operation and is comfortable working with pricing, vendor quotations, customer requirements, CRM systems, and sales documentation.



Responsibilities include preparing and tracking customer estimates and quotes, obtaining vendor pricing, assisting with bid and proposal preparation, maintaining accurate CRM records, and coordinating the administrative activities necessary to move sales opportunities forward.



This position is not a general executive or personal assistant role. Candidates should have demonstrated experience in sales administration, sales operations, estimating, quoting, or proposal coordination.



Key Responsibilities & Duties



1. Sales Administration & Operations

Provide direct administrative and operational support to the Sales Team throughout the sales cycle, from initial customer inquiry through quote submission and order processing.

Prepare, format, review, and distribute customer quotations, sales estimates, proposals, and other sales documentation.

Generate sales orders, purchase orders, and related documentation as needed.

Track outstanding quotes, pending customer responses, follow-ups, and sales opportunities.

Maintain accurate and up-to-date customer, contact, opportunity, and activity records within the CRM.

Monitor sales pipeline activity and ensure opportunities are updated with current status, notes, next steps, and relevant documentation.

Assist the Sales Team with researching customer requirements, product specifications, and potential solutions.

Coordinate with internal departments to ensure sales commitments, pricing, and project details are properly documented.

Assist with preparing sales reports, pipeline summaries, and other sales performance metrics.



2. Estimating, Quoting & Pricing

Prepare detailed cost estimates and customer quotations for equipment, materials, labor, and services.

Review customer requests, project specifications, bills of materials (BOMs), and other technical documentation to identify required products and services.

Request and obtain pricing, availability, and lead-time information from manufacturers, distributors, and suppliers.

Analyze vendor quotations and compare pricing, specifications, and availability to support purchasing and sales decisions.

Calculate product costs, labor costs, markups, margins, and customer pricing with a high degree of accuracy.

Identify pricing discrepancies, missing information, and potential cost considerations before quotes are submitted.

Maintain and update pricing databases, vendor records, and historical cost information.

Assist in identifying cost-saving opportunities and alternative products or solutions.

Track estimated versus actual costs when applicable.



3. Proposals, Bids & Documentation

Assist with preparing and coordinating Requests for Quotes (RFQs), Requests for Proposals (RFPs), and formal bid submissions.

Review bid requirements and ensure requested documentation, pricing, and supporting information are compiled accurately.

Coordinate with vendors, manufacturers, and internal technical personnel to obtain information required for proposals.

Prepare and organize proposal packages, pricing schedules, equipment lists, and supporting documentation.

Maintain organized records of submitted quotes, proposals, revisions, and supporting documents.

Track proposal deadlines and submission requirements to ensure timely delivery.



4. Vendor & Order Coordination

Communicate with vendors and distributors to obtain product pricing, availability, specifications, and estimated delivery dates.

Assist with procurement activities, including preparing and issuing purchase orders.

Track order confirmations, vendor acknowledgments, and shipment updates.

Coordinate with Sales, Project Management, and Accounting to resolve pricing, ordering, and documentation discrepancies.

Maintain accurate records of vendor quotations, purchase orders, and related transactions.



5. CRM, Systems & Reporting

Maintain accurate customer, vendor, product, and opportunity information within company systems.

Ensure sales activities, communications, estimates, and follow-up actions are properly documented.

Generate and maintain sales, estimating, and operational reports.

Assist with improving sales administrative processes, documentation standards, and workflow efficiency.

Maintain organized electronic files and records in accordance with company procedures.



Qualifications & Experience



Required Experience

2–5 years of experience in sales administration, sales operations, estimating, quoting, proposal coordination, or a similar sales-support position.

Demonstrated experience preparing customer quotations, estimates, pricing schedules, or sales proposals.

Previous experience working directly with a sales team in a business-to-business (B2B) environment.

Experience obtaining and reviewing vendor or supplier quotations.

Experience working with CRM systems and maintaining sales pipeline records.

Strong mathematical and analytical skills, including the ability to calculate costs, markups, margins, and pricing.



Preferred Experience

Experience in the IT, technology, telecommunications, security systems, construction, engineering, electrical, or systems integration industries.

Experience reviewing bills of materials (BOMs), equipment lists, technical specifications, or project scopes.

Experience with RFQs, RFPs, and formal bid submissions.

Familiarity with procurement and purchase order processes.

Experience with Zoho CRM, Zoho Books, 
, or similar business management platforms.

Post-secondary education in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Construction Management, or a related field.



Required Skills & Competencies

Strong proficiency in Google Workspace, particularly Google Sheets, Google Docs, Gmail, and Google Drive.

Intermediate to advanced spreadsheet skills, including formulas, data organization, and pricing calculations.

Experience with Adobe Acrobat and electronic document preparation.

Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy, particularly when working with pricing and financial information.

Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate professionally with customers, vendors, and internal personnel.

Excellent organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple quotes, deadlines, and competing priorities.

Ability to independently research information, identify discrepancies, and follow tasks through to completion.

Process-oriented mindset with a focus on accuracy, consistency, and efficiency.

High level of integrity, accountability, and professionalism.



Education

High School Diploma or equivalent required.

Post-secondary education or relevant professional training preferred.



Ideal Candidate

The successful candidate is someone who understands how a sales department operates and enjoys the coordination and detail-oriented work that supports the sales process.



They should be comfortable working with numbers, pricing, spreadsheets, vendor communications, customer quotations, and CRM systems. They must be proactive, organized, and capable of managing multiple sales-related tasks without requiring constant direction.



Candidates whose experience is primarily in executive assistance, personal assistance, general office administration, or calendar and meeting management, without direct sales administration, quoting, estimating, or sales operations experience, are not the intended fit for this position.

SCHEDULE

Full-time, 11 hours a day, Monday to Friday, on Central Time (Houston) business hours, covering our phone hours of about 8am to 6pm CST. That means evening or overnight hours in the Philippines. No weekend work. Exact shift hours are confirmed at hiring. No time tracking tool.

 

TERMS

Independent contractor, paid biweekly via Wise or direct to bank. 3-month probationary period, then the base rate increases to $4.00 USD per hour. Base pay plus incentives. The incentive structure is discussed directly with the selected candidate.

 

HOW TO APPLY (please follow all steps; incomplete applications are not reviewed)

1. Start your message with the word BEE so we know you read this post.

2. Send your resume link.

3. Write 3 to 4 sentences about your experience: industries and accounts handled, years of inbound calls, and one result with a number (bookings, conversion rate, or sales).

4. Send an audio recording of 1 to 2 minutes (voice note or link), recorded for this application. Say your name and the word BEE, then answer:

   a) Tell us about a call you closed: what the customer wanted, what you said, and how it ended.

   b) A homeowner says "I'll think about it" after hearing the price. What do you say next to move toward a booking without pressure?

5. Tell us your earliest start date.

 

Applications without an audio recording are not reviewed.

 

Shortlisted applicants complete a short assessment (a call role-play plus a simple admin task such as organizing an inbox or schedule).

title: U.S. Tax Preparer
description:
About ERPS Group



ERPS Group is a fast-growing accounting, tax, and business advisory firm dedicated to helping business owners build stronger, more profitable companies. We provide accounting, tax planning, bookkeeping, payroll, CFO advisory, and business consulting services to clients across multiple industries.



Our mission is to deliver exceptional client service while helping entrepreneurs make informed financial decisions and achieve long-term success. We believe in professionalism, accountability, continuous improvement, and teamwork. Every member of our team plays an important role in creating an outstanding client experience.



We are looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented, and experienced U.S. Tax Preparer & Reviewer to join our growing team.

This position requires practical experience preparing U.S. tax returns, reviewing returns for accuracy and completeness before submission, and maintaining a strong understanding of U.S. federal and state tax regulations.



The ideal candidate is analytical, proactive, highly responsible, and capable of working independently while collaborating effectively with our U.S.-based team.



Key Responsibilities



1. U.S. Tax Return Preparation



Prepare accurate U.S. individual and business tax returns.

Work with various tax forms, including but not limited to Forms 1040, 1120, 1120-S, and 1065.

Review financial statements, supporting documentation, and client-provided information to ensure accurate tax reporting.

Identify potential tax deductions, credits, and tax-saving opportunities within applicable tax regulations.

Ensure tax returns are prepared in compliance with current U.S. federal and applicable state tax laws.

Identify missing, inconsistent, or questionable information and request clarification when necessary.



2. Tax Return Review & Quality Control



Independently review prepared tax returns before submission to identify errors, inconsistencies, omissions, and potential compliance issues.

Verify calculations, supporting schedules, income reporting, deductions, credits, and tax liabilities.

Ensure all required forms, disclosures, and supporting documentation are included.

Identify potential tax risks and escalate complex or unusual tax situations to the appropriate manager or tax professional.

Maintain high standards of accuracy and quality while meeting established turnaround times.

Ensure all returns pass internal quality-control procedures before being finalized for filing.



3. Tax Research & Compliance



Maintain an up-to-date understanding of U.S. federal and state tax regulations.

Research tax questions and provide well-supported answers based on reliable IRS guidance and applicable tax authorities.

Stay informed about annual tax law changes, filing requirements, and regulatory updates.

Assist with resolving tax return discrepancies and responding to internal review comments.

Maintain proper documentation of research, calculations, and decisions.



4. Client Documentation & Workflow Management



Organize and maintain tax documents, workpapers, and client records.

Identify missing documentation and communicate outstanding requirements to the appropriate team members.

Maintain accurate records of assigned returns, progress, review status, and deadlines.

Work efficiently with the accounting and customer care teams to ensure a smooth tax preparation process.

Handle confidential financial and personal information with the highest level of discretion.



5. Team Collaboration & Accountability



Collaborate with U.S.-based tax professionals, accountants, and management.

Follow established company procedures, workflows, and quality standards.

Meet daily and weekly production targets without compromising accuracy.

Communicate proactively regarding delays, issues, or potential compliance concerns.

Take ownership of assigned returns from preparation through internal review and completion.



Required Qualifications & Experience



Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience preparing U.S. tax returns.

Demonstrated experience with both individual and business tax returns.

Strong knowledge of U.S. federal income tax regulations and familiarity with state taxation.

Practical experience reviewing tax returns for accuracy, completeness, and compliance before filing.

Strong understanding of IRS forms, instructions, and filing requirements.

Experience working with U.S. accounting and tax preparation software.

Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to understand complex U.S. tax terminology and communicate effectively with U.S.-based professionals.

Strong analytical, research, and problem-solving skills.

Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.

Excellent organizational and time-management skills.

Ability to manage multiple tax returns and deadlines simultaneously.

Ability to work independently, take initiative, and meet performance expectations.



Preferred Qualifications



Experience with professional tax preparation software such as ProSeries.

Experience working with QuickBooks Online and Desktop

Experience with U.S. accounting firms, CPA firms, or tax advisory companies.

Experience with real estate taxation, rental income, depreciation, S corporations, partnerships, and multi-entity business structures.

Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.



What We Offer



Competitive compensation based on experience and qualifications.

Long-term, full-time employment opportunity.

Opportunity to work with an established U.S.-based accounting and financial consulting firm.

Professional development and exposure to complex U.S. tax matters.

Collaborative international team environment.

Opportunities for career growth and advancement.



How to Apply



Please submit two links to: your resume and a 1-min video explaining why you’re the perfect fit for this role. We're looking for a driven leader ready to help us 10X our impact while creating transformational results for our clients and team.

Important: Candidates must have actual professional experience preparing U.S. tax returns. General bookkeeping or accounting experience without direct U.S. tax preparation experience will not meet the requirements for this position.

title: FULL-TIME CSR / APPOINTMENT SETTER — HOME SERVICE LEADS (GOHIGHLEVEL REQUIRED)
description:
READ THIS BEFORE APPLYING

This role requires previous experience calling leads for home service businesses (waterproofing, foundation repair, crawl space, concrete, roofing, HVAC, plumbing, remodeling, pest control, solar, and similar). This is the minimum requirement, not a preference. If you do not have it, do not apply. Your application will not be reviewed.



ABOUT DRYSCALE

DryScale runs lead generation for waterproofing, crawl space, foundation repair, and concrete contractors across the United States. We get some of the best results in the space and are one of the fastest-growing agencies on the market. Our ads bring in homeowners with a real problem at the house (water in the basement, a cracking foundation, a sinking driveway) who have asked to be contacted. You are the person who calls them.



Because we're growing this fast, we need a high-quality, long-term partner in this CSR role, not a short-term hire. If you're looking for a few months of work, this isn't it.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Dial every new B2C lead that comes in across our client accounts, fast. Speed-to-lead is the job.

- Book the homeowner for a free in-home inspection and estimate on the client's calendar in GoHighLevel.

- Work the follow-up: no-answers, callbacks, texts, and older leads that never booked.

- Confirm upcoming appointments so they actually hold.

- Keep GHL clean: correct pipeline stage, notes on every conversation, tags, and call outcomes.

- Handle multiple client accounts, each with its own services, service area, and calendar.

- Flag out-of-area requests, wrong-service leads, and anything the client's office needs to know.



REQUIREMENTS (ALL FIVE ARE REQUIRED)

1. Experience calling for home service businesses. Minimum requirement, see above.

2. Familiar with GoHighLevel (GHL): contacts, conversations, pipelines, and calendars.

3. At least 3 years of experience in previous roles (phone-based customer service, appointment setting, or inside sales).

4. Very fluent in English. You will be on the phone with US homeowners all day: clear, confident, and easy to understand.

5. Able to work a full-time position on US Eastern Time hours.



You'll also need reliable internet, a quiet workspace, and a good headset.



COMPENSATION

$1,500–$2,000 USD per month on-target earnings: base pay plus performance pay tied to the appointments you book.



HOW TO APPLY: SEND A 1-MINUTE VIDEO

There are no interviews at this stage. To apply, record a quick video (about 1 minute) of yourself reading the call script below, then send it to us.



Your video must:

- Show your face on camera.

- Start with your name and the home service industries you've called for, then go straight into the script.

- Be recorded with the headset or mic you'd actually use on calls, in the space you'd actually work from. We want to hear what homeowners would hear.

- Sound like a real call. Don't just read the words. Say it the way you would to a homeowner on the phone.



Read only your own lines. You don't need to act out the homeowner.



EXAMPLE SCRIPT: FOUNDATION REPAIR NEW LEAD CALL



"Hi, is this Mark? Hey Mark, this is [your name] with Summit Foundation Repair. You filled out a form on our site a few minutes ago about some cracks in your foundation. Did I catch you at an okay time?



Great. Just so I understand what's going on: are the cracks inside the basement, on the outside walls, or both? And have you noticed any doors sticking, or windows that don't close like they used to?



Okay, that's really helpful. That's exactly what our inspectors want to look at before it gets any worse. What we'll do is send a specialist out to the house for a free inspection. They'll show you what's causing it and give you a written estimate right there, no cost and no obligation.



I've got Thursday at 10 AM or Friday at 2 PM open in your area. Which one works better for you?



Perfect, you're all set for Thursday at 10. You'll get a text confirmation in the next few minutes. Thanks, Mark. Talk soon."



HOW TO SEND IT

Reply to this post with all four of the following:

1. A link to your video (Loom, unlisted YouTube, or Google Drive set to "Anyone with the link can view").

2. Confirmation that you meet the minimum requirements, including which home service businesses you've called for.

3. Confirmation that you can work full-time on US Eastern Time hours.

4. Confirmation that you're familiar with GoHighLevel.



If anything is missing, or the video link doesn't open, your application will not be reviewed. Consider this the first test of the job: following instructions exactly is what this role is.



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT

We'll watch every video and reach out directly to the applicants we think are the best fit. If you don't hear from us, you were not selected this round.



We're looking forward to hearing from you!

title: Moodle LMS Developer
description:
Job Type: Full-Time, Long-Term Remote

Schedule: 7–8 hours/day, 5 days/week

Working Hours: 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM Toronto Time (Eastern Time)

Compensation: CAD $4/hour

Probation Period: 1.5 months

Work Location: Remote

Hiring: Immediate



Job Description



Springfield College is seeking an experienced and reliable Moodle LMS Developer to lead the migration of our existing Learning Management System (LMS) from Classe365 to Moodle.



The primary focus of this position is to successfully migrate our existing courses, learning materials, student records, and relevant LMS data while establishing a fully functional, organized, and user-friendly Moodle environment.



The successful candidate will also be responsible for customizing Moodle's interface to closely replicate the structure, navigation, and user experience of our existing Classe365 platform, while incorporating Springfield College's branding and academic requirements.



This is a long-term remote position involving LMS migration, Moodle development, configuration, troubleshooting, and ongoing technical support. We are looking for someone who can independently manage technical tasks, solve migration challenges, and ensure a smooth transition with minimal disruption to academic operations.



Key Responsibilities



1. Classe365 to Moodle Migration



Assess the existing Classe365 LMS, including its course structures, user records, learning materials, and administrative configurations.



Develop and execute a structured migration plan from Classe365 to Moodle.



Extract, transfer, and import existing courses, course content, student and instructor records, enrolments, and other available LMS data.



Preserve course organization, learning resources, assessments, and student progress records wherever technically feasible.



Identify and resolve data compatibility, import, export, and migration issues.



Verify migrated information for accuracy, completeness, and proper functionality.



2. Moodle LMS Development & Configuration



Install, configure, customize, and maintain the Moodle LMS environment.



Recreate existing course structures, categories, modules, and learning pathways within Moodle.



Configure user accounts, roles, permissions, enrolment methods, grading systems, assessments, and course completion tracking.



Develop or modify Moodle functionality to meet the college's academic and administrative requirements.



Ensure the new Moodle environment operates reliably and efficiently.



3. Moodle Theme & Interface Customization



Develop or customize a Moodle theme to closely match the existing Classe365 user interface and experience.



Customize the homepage, student and instructor dashboards, course pages, login page, navigation, and other interface components.



Incorporate Springfield College's branding, logo, colours, and design guidelines.



Ensure a modern, responsive, accessible, and user-friendly experience across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.



Implement interface improvements and revisions based on feedback from the college team.



4. Plugin Configuration & System Integrations



Research, install, configure, and customize Moodle plugins based on academic and operational requirements.



Modify existing plugins or develop custom functionality where necessary.



Configure integrations with external platforms, including WordPress, Zoom, Microsoft Teams, and other relevant services when required.



Support automated student account creation, enrolment, notifications, and administrative workflows.



Troubleshoot plugin conflicts, integration issues, and compatibility problems.



5. Testing, Documentation & Ongoing Support



Thoroughly test migrated courses, user accounts, enrolments, learning resources, and LMS functionality.



Identify and resolve errors, missing data, broken links, layout issues, and configuration problems.



Validate that the new Moodle environment meets the college's academic and administrative requirements before deployment.



Document migration procedures, customizations, configurations, and technical resolutions.



Assist college staff with Moodle course creation, content management, and system administration.



Provide ongoing technical support, maintenance, and improvements following the migration.



Required Skills & Experience



Demonstrated experience in Moodle LMS development, administration, configuration, theme customization, and plugin implementation.



Experience with LMS migrations, course content transfers, data imports/exports, and database management.



Strong working knowledge of PHP, HTML, CSS/SCSS, JavaScript, and SQL/MySQL.



Familiarity with Moodle's architecture, database structure, APIs, themes, and plugins.



Understanding of LMS course structures, assessments, user accounts, enrolments, grading, and progress tracking.



Ability to troubleshoot data migration issues and ensure data accuracy and integrity.



Experience creating responsive and accessible LMS interfaces.



Strong problem-solving, organizational, documentation, and communication skills.



Ability to work independently, coordinate with stakeholders, and meet agreed deadlines.



Additional Experience Considered an Asset:



Previous experience with Classe365 or migrations from similar LMS platforms.



Experience working with REST APIs and third-party LMS integrations.



Experience with Moodle course backups, restores, and bulk user imports.



Experience integrating Moodle with WordPress, Zoom, or Microsoft Teams.



Previous experience working with colleges, universities, or other educational institutions.



Application Requirements



Applicants must provide the following:



Resume: An up-to-date resume outlining relevant technical experience and qualifications.



Portfolio (Mandatory): Examples of Moodle websites, themes, plugins, or LMS migration projects you have worked on, including a brief explanation of your contributions.



Video Introduction (Mandatory): A short video introducing yourself and describing your relevant Moodle development and LMS migration experience.



Availability Confirmation: Confirmation that you can work 8 hours per day, 5 days per week, from 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM Toronto time.



Compensation Confirmation: Confirmation that you accept the starting rate of CAD $4/hour and the 1.5-month probation period.



Interview Contact: An active
 address for scheduling a Zoom or Microsoft Teams interview.



Important: Applications without a resume, relevant Moodle portfolio, and short video introduction will not be considered.



We are looking to hire immediately and are seeking a dependable developer who can contribute to the successful migration from Classe365 to Moodle and support the college's LMS development and maintenance over the long term.

title: US Healthcare Accountant
description:
Opportunity: Work with US-based businesses

Level: Healthcare Accounting



Ready to take your accounting career global?



Are you an experienced Healthcare Accountant, or an Accountant who has worked with US medical, dental, or healthcare practices, looking to work with US-based companies?



If you’ve managed the books for healthcare organizations, reconciled insurance and patient payments, and owned month-end close, this could be an exciting next step.



Through MAVI, you can explore remote opportunities with US healthcare businesses, own important accounting processes, and build international experience, all while working from the Philippines.



About MAVI



Great talent shouldn’t be limited by geography.



At MAVI, we connect exceptional finance and accounting professionals with US companies, opening doors to meaningful international career opportunities.



We believe the best professionals deserve opportunities to make an impact, take ownership, and grow their careers, wherever they’re based.



What You’ll Own



• Practice Accounting: Keep the books for medical, dental, behavioral health, physical therapy, or veterinary practices, often across multiple locations or entities.

• Revenue & Deposit Reconciliations: Reconcile insurance payer payments, patient payments, and ERA/EOB data (the payment statements from insurers) against practice management system reports and bank deposits.

• Patient & Insurance AR: Track AR by payer, record contractual adjustments and write-offs, and support reporting on collections and outstanding balances.

• Month-End Close: Prepare journal entries, accruals, and prepaids, and do balance sheet reconciliations for a timely, accurate close.

• Provider Compensation & Payroll: Support provider compensation calculations, payroll entries, and expense allocations across locations.

• Reporting & Analysis: Prepare financial statements, location-level P&Ls, and KPI reports (collections, revenue per provider, overhead ratios) for US practice owners and finance leads.



What We’re Looking For



• Healthcare accounting experience: 4+ years of accounting for US healthcare practices, groups, or healthcare service businesses.

• Strong accounting fundamentals: A solid grasp of accrual accounting, reconciliations, and how revenue and adjustments flow into the financial statements.

• Multi-location experience: Able to manage the books for several locations or entities at once without losing accuracy.

• Confidentiality and attention to detail: Comfortable handling sensitive financial and patient-related data in line with HIPAA requirements.

• Strong English communication: Comfortable working directly with US practice owners, office managers, and finance teams.



Good to Have



• Experience with QuickBooks Online, Xero, NetSuite, or Sage Intacct.

• Familiarity with practice management or EHR systems like athenahealth, Tebra (Kareo), eClinicalWorks, NextGen, Dentrix, Open Dental, or Eaglesoft.

• Experience with private equity-backed healthcare groups, MSOs (management service organizations), or practice roll-ups.

• Background in US medical billing or revenue cycle management (RCM).

• A bachelor’s degree in Accountancy, Accounting Technology, or Management Accounting. A Philippine CPA license is a plus.



Why Explore This Opportunity?



🌎 International Exposure: Work with US-based healthcare businesses and gain valuable cross-border accounting experience.

🏡 Remote Flexibility: Explore opportunities that let you work from the Philippines while collaborating with international teams.

💼 Meaningful Ownership: Take responsibility for the financial operations behind practices that serve patients every day.

📈 Professional Growth: Build specialized expertise in US healthcare accounting and grow toward Senior Accountant or Controller roles.

💵 Competitive Opportunities: Competitive USD-denominated compensation.

title: Remote Financial Controller (CPA-Level): Lead Accounting Across 3 US Entities
description:
Own the accounting. Help build what comes next.



We're a growing US-based, technology-enabled services business looking for an experienced Financial Controller to lead hands-on accounting across three related entities.



You'll take ownership of the books, establish dependable reporting, and strengthen the processes behind the numbers. You'll also work directly with business and technical leadership to improve systems and reduce unnecessary manual work.



This role suits someone who brings CPA-level accounting judgment, enjoys solving problems, and communicates clearly. You should be comfortable doing the detailed work while helping build an accounting function that can grow with the business.



What you'll own



-- Multi-entity accounting: Maintain accurate books, reconciliations, and intercompany balances across three related businesses.

-- Monthly close and reporting: Establish a consistent close process and deliver timely financial statements with clear explanations of results.

-- Day-to-day financial operations: Manage invoicing, accounts receivable, accounts payable, and payment preparation within appropriate approval processes.

-- Fee and payment accounting: Ensure customer-specific pricing and payment arrangements are accurately reflected in the books.

-- Cash visibility: Maintain practical cash forecasts and flag cash needs, unusual balances, and discrepancies early.

-- Processes and controls: Document workflows, strengthen financial safeguards, and make recurring work more reliable.

-- Systems improvement: Partner with technical leadership to identify automation opportunities, explain accounting requirements, and verify that improvements work correctly.

-- External coordination: Prepare organized records and work with outside tax and accounting advisers as needed.



You'll stay involved in the daily work while improving how it gets done.



What you bring



-- CPA-level skills and experience, shown through meaningful ownership of accounting, monthly close, and financial reporting.

-- Strong knowledge of accrual accounting and experience supporting US-based businesses.

-- Advanced QuickBooks Online proficiency.

-- Experience managing multiple entities, including intercompany transactions and reconciliations.

-- Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.

-- Excellent spoken and written English, with the ability to explain numbers simply and clearly to people without an accounting background. You can join live discussions with confidence, write clear updates, and ask precise questions.

-- The ability to investigate discrepancies, work through incomplete information, and recognize when an issue needs clarification or escalation.

-- Availability to work a consistent schedule aligned with US business hours, with some flexibility in start and end times.

-- A reliable remote-work setup, stable internet, and a practical backup plan.



Experience improving accounting processes, handling complex billing arrangements, or working with software integrations and automation is especially valuable.



How you work



-- You follow through. You keep priorities moving, meet commitments, and surface problems early.

-- You exercise sound judgment. You investigate before drawing conclusions, document important assumptions, and make unresolved issues visible.

-- You look for practical improvements. You notice recurring problems and help fix the process behind them.

-- You protect accuracy. You welcome better tools while maintaining appropriate review, approvals, and accountability.

-- You stay hands-on. You're comfortable reconciling a difficult account, preparing reports, and discussing improvements with leadership.



Your first 90 days



You'll develop a clear understanding of the entities, books, and transaction flows. You'll identify the most important gaps and agree on priorities with leadership.



From there, you'll establish a dependable close and reporting routine, improve cash visibility, document core workflows, and begin implementing practical improvements. Priorities and timing will reflect the condition of the books and the resources available.



Why join us



-- Meaningful ownership: Help shape how the accounting function operates.

-- Direct collaboration: Work closely with business and technical decision-makers.

-- Practical use of technology: Help turn recurring manual work into reliable processes.

-- Room to grow: Develop your responsibilities as the business and accounting function evolve.

-- Fully remote work: Work from the Philippines with a consistent, agreed schedule.



Schedule



-- Location: Remote, Philippines.

-- Commitment: Full-time.

-- Schedule: US business hours, with a couple of hours of flexibility in start and end times. We'll agree on a consistent schedule during hiring that supports regular collaboration with the US team. This generally means evening and overnight work in the Philippines.



How to apply



Send your application to 
 using this subject line:



Application – Financial Controller – [Your Full Name]



We may not review applications that don't use this subject line.



Your
 should include the following.



1. Résumé (PDF)

List your accounting roles, the entities and industries you supported, and the systems you used.



2. Video introduction (2–3 minutes)

Record a short video and share it as a link through Loom, Google Drive, or an unlisted YouTube video. Make sure anyone with the link can view it. In the video, cover:

-- Who you are and your current or most recent role

-- The CPA-level work you've owned for a US-based business

-- Your experience with QuickBooks Online and multi-entity accounting

-- How you'd explain a financial result to someone who isn't an accountant

-- Why this role interests you



Please speak naturally rather than reading from a script. We want to hear how you explain things.



3. Written answers to these questions

-- What accounting functions have you personally owned for a US-based business?

-- Describe your QuickBooks Online and multi-entity accounting experience.

-- Share one accounting process you improved. What did you change, and how did you verify the result?

-- Describe how you resolved incomplete records or a difficult reconciliation.

-- Confirm your availability for US business hours, your preferred working hours, and your earliest start date.



We won't consider incomplete applications, including those missing the video link or the written answers.



Shortlisted candidates may complete a practical accounting exercise and discuss their approach in a live interview.



We're looking for someone who makes the numbers dependable, communicates clearly, and helps the business operate better.

title: YouTube Video Editor & Content Repurposing Specialist
description:
About me:

I’m an established guitar educator with 35 years of teaching experience, thousands of students taught, two published books, and an existing social media presence with thousands of subscribers and millions of views. I’m building my online education business and looking for a reliable, creative person who can help me consistently produce and publish high-quality video content. I will be the face and voice of the business. My job is to teach guitar and record content. Your job is to help turn my recordings into finished videos which are ready to publish. I’m looking for a long-term working relationship with someone who is organized, communicates well, takes initiative, and can follow a repeatable workflow.



Responsibilities: 

Initially, your primary responsibilities will include:

- Editing long-form YouTube guitar lessons from my recorded footage.

- Creating three to five short-form clips from each suitable long-form video for YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, and other platforms.

- Adding captions and making appropriate cuts, transitions, and audio adjustments.

- Creating engaging YouTube thumbnails.

- Writing or preparing video titles, descriptions, and other publishing details.

- Organizing video files and maintaining a simple content production tracker.

- Uploading and scheduling approved content once we’ve established a workflow.

- As we develop our working relationship, there may be opportunities to take on additional responsibilities.



Required qualifications

I’m looking for someone who:



- Has experience editing YouTube videos and short-form social media content.

- Can provide examples of previous work.

- Understands pacing, storytelling, and how to keep viewers engaged.

- Has experience with captions, audio cleanup, and basic color correction.

- Can create clean, professional thumbnails.

- Is organized, dependable, and responsive.

- Can follow instructions and accept constructive feedback.

- Is comfortable working independently and meeting deadlines.

- Experience with educational content, musicians, guitar instruction, or other instructional video channels is a plus.



How we will work together: 

- I will provide the original recordings, teaching expertise, and direction.

- You will be responsible for editing and preparing the finished content according to our agreed workflow.

- I want to spend my time teaching on camera, not managing complicated editing software or handling every technical detail of video production.

- I’m interested in someone who can eventually manage the process from receiving the footage to delivering finished, publish-ready content.



Paid test project: 

- Before making a longer-term commitment, I would like to start with a small paid test project.

- I will provide a previously recorded guitar lesson. Your task will be to:

- Edit one long-form YouTube video.

- Create three short-form clips from the same recording.

- Prepare a thumbnail for the long-form video.

- Suggest a title and prepare the video description.

- Please tell me your proposed price and estimated turnaround time for this test project.

- I will evaluate the quality of your work, communication, reliability, and ability to follow instructions.



How to apply: 

Please include the following in your application:



- A brief introduction and description of your experience.

- Links to three examples of videos you have edited.

- Your experience creating YouTube Shorts or Instagram Reels.

- The editing software you use.

- Your proposed rate for the paid test project.

- Your typical turnaround time.

- Your availability and preferred working hours.



Please begin your application with the words GUITAR VIDEO EDITOR so I know you have read the entire posting.

I’m looking for someone who wants to build a reliable, long-term working relationship and help grow an established educational brand.



Thank you for your interest!

Scott Miller

Scott Miller Music Studios
