title: Customer Support Agent | Fast-Growing D2C E-commerce Brand | Full-Time
description:
This role is for someone who can own customer conversations end to end, protect the reputation of a fast-growing brand, and help build the support systems that make that reputation repeatable as volume climbs.



The Role



We’re looking for a Customer Support Agent with proven experience inside a 7-, 8- or 9-figure e-commerce brand.



You need to understand brand reputation, not just ticket closing.



Our existing support lead handles the current queue and will hand over process, tone and tooling. Your job is to take real ownership of your share of the conversations:



Answer every ticket in the brand voice, not in generic support language.

Resolve the actual problem, not just the message in front of you.

Spot the pattern behind repeat tickets and flag it upstream.

Turn an unhappy customer into someone who recommends us.

Protect response time and resolution quality as volume grows.

Improve the process rather than simply following it.



The goal isn’t to clear the inbox. The goal is that every single person who contacts us walks away with the best experience we’re capable of giving them.



What You’ll Own



You’ll own a full share of the daily support queue across
 and social channels, alongside the rest of the support team.



Your responsibilities will include:

Handling customer enquiries across
, social DMs and comments.

Order issues: tracking, delays, address changes, damaged or missing items.

Refunds, replacements and exchanges, within the brand’s policy and tiers.

Pre-purchase questions where the customer needs help d
.

Escalations and difficult conversations, handled calmly and without defensiveness.

Maintaining accurate notes so any teammate can pick up a thread cold.

Reviewing and improving canned responses and macros as the product range changes.

Writing and maintaining support SOPs as the team and the ticket volume grow.

Flagging recurring issues to the operations and product side with the evidence behind them.

Supporting review and reputation workflows so happy customers actually leave feedback.

Hitting response time and satisfaction standards consistently, not occasionally.

Taking ownership of the customer outcome rather than passing it along.

Who We’re Looking For



Non-negotiables



Proven customer support experience with a successful DTC/e-commerce brand, ideally at 7-, 8- or 9-figure scale.

Hands-on experience using CommSlayer. This is a requirement, not a preference.

Hands-on experience with Shopify, plus any additional support platform such as Gorgias, Zendesk or Reamaze.

Excellent written English. Clear, warm, natural, never robotic.

Strong knowledge of standard e-commerce support situations: shipping, fulfilment, returns, chargebacks, disputes.

Highly collaborative. You communicate proactively with teammates rather than working in silence.

Ability to hold quality at volume, especially on a heavy day.

Comfortable writing process documentation, not only using it.

Genuinely invested in the long-term vision of the brand you work for.

Full-time availability, 40+ hours per week, with reliable internet and a quiet working setup.

The mindset



We’re looking for someone who is:



Genuinely warm toward customers, including the difficult ones.

Extremely reliable.

Proactive rather than reactive.

Comfortable taking ownership of an outcome.

Curious about why a customer is unhappy, not merely how to close the ticket.

Interested in building a support function, not just working a shift in one.

Excited by a fast-moving environment where standards continue to rise.



If you need a script for every situation before you can reply to a customer, this isn’t the right role.



What Great Looks Like



A great support agent on our team doesn’t read a message and ask:



“Which macro do I send here?”



They ask:



“What does this person actually need from us to feel looked after?”



If a template covers it, use it.



If it doesn’t, write the reply the customer deserves.



If the same issue reaches us three times in a week, say so and fix the cause.



You should be thinking about:



What is this customer really worried about underneath the question?

Is my reply solving it, or just acknowledging it?

Would I be happy receiving this message?

Where is the friction that created this ticket in the first place?

Could this have been prevented upstream?

Is there anything I can do here beyond the minimum?

Does this person now think more of the brand, or less?

What should we write down so nobody has to solve this from scratch again?

Building The Support System



SOP building is a core part of this role, not an optional extra.



You should be comfortable documenting and improving process across areas such as:



Standard response libraries and tone guidelines

Refund, replacement and exchange decision trees

Shipping and tracking escalation steps

Chargeback and dispute handling

Review and reputation workflows

Handover notes and shift documentation

Reporting on ticket volume, themes and resolution time

Onboarding material for the next person who joins the support team



We want to see examples of process you’ve actually built or improved, and the difference it made.



Output & Working Rhythm

Full-time, 40+ hours per week.

Daily queue ownership with agreed response time standards.

Close communication with the rest of the support team and with operations.

Weekly reporting on themes, recurring issues and anything that needs fixing upstream.

For the right person, there is a clear opportunity to grow into:

We’re ambitious about where we’re taking the brand, and customer experience is one of the most important reasons customers choose us and tell other people about us.

Application Process



Start your application with the word “RESOLVED”



If your application doesn’t begin with that word, we’ll assume you haven’t read the full brief.



Then include:



A short introduction and the DTC/e-commerce brands you’ve supported.

The support platforms and tools you’ve used, and what you used each for, including how long you’ve worked in CommSlayer and what you handled inside it.

Your typical daily ticket volume and average response time in your last role.

A brief explanation of your goals for your own development over the next 1 to 2 years.

Cashing Homes is a growing U.S.-based real estate investment company specializing in nationwide wholesale novation transactions.



We operate across multiple states and are looking for a highly skilled, detail-oriented Real Estate Underwriter to join our team.

- Determine competitive listing prices and recommended acquisition offers for novation transactions.

- Understand local market conditions, buyer demand, and property-specific factors that influence value.

- Work closely with our acquisitions team to provide accurate and timely underwriting.

- Strong understanding of comparable sales, ARV calculations, as-is values, and retail listing strategies.

- Excellent attention to detail, analytical skills, and time management.

We're looking for someone who genuinely understands real estate valuation and can think critically rather than simply follow a formula.

- Long-term career opportunities for the right candidate.

title: AI Systems Architect
description:
Remote · Full-time · Eastern Time Schedule . ₱100,000–₱115,000/month depending on experience + HMO + 10 days paid leave after 6 months,



About the role:



We're looking for a hands-on AI Systems Architect to design, build and run the AI foundation our whole organization will work on.



You'll shape how our teams and clients use AI agents day to day, so people spend less time on repetitive work and more time on work that matters. This is a build role, not an advisory one. You'll write production code, make the architecture calls and set the standards others build on.

If you enjoy turning messy business workflows into reliable, secure AI systems, and you care whether they actually make people's work better, we'd like to hear from you.



What you'll do:



• Design our AI architecture. Set the standards for models, agents, orchestration, memory, tools, data access and human review.

• Build AI agents that work in production. Create agents, multi-agent systems and reusable services that teams can rely on.

• D
 what AI should and shouldn't do. Choose when work belongs to an AI agent, regular software, an automated workflow or a person.

• Set up how people work with agents. Define each agent's job, tools, permissions and escalation rules, and how people assign, review and accept its work.

• Keep things secure across clients. Design a multi-client setup that keeps each client's data separate and protects confidential information.

• Measure quality. Build evaluation and testing that tracks accuracy, reliability, cost, speed and rework, and catches hallucinations and bad recommendations.

• Guard against AI-specific risks. Handle prompt injection, data leakage and unauthorized tool use, with clear audit trails and human approval where it counts.

• Turn business needs into working systems. Translate requirements into workflows, integrations and clear acceptance criteria.

• Lead and coach developers. Give direction, review work and help others build with the patterns you set.

• Solve the hard problems yourself. Stay close enough to the code to understand real effort and risk.



What you'll bring:



•5+ years of professional software engineering, including at least 2 years building AI/LLM systems used by real users or clients

• A track record of building AI agents or multi-agent systems

• Strong hands-on software engineering skills and experience with enterprise or platform architecture

• Practical experience with LLMs, structured outputs, tool calling, retrieval and orchestration

• Experience connecting AI systems to applications, databases, knowledge sources and APIs

• Experience building evaluation, testing and quality checks for AI

• Experience with authentication, permissions, audit logging and data protection

• Experience deploying, monitoring and supporting AI systems in production

• A history of turning business workflows into secure technical solutions and leading delivery

• Evidence that your work produced measurable improvements in operations, productivity or revenue

We don't require any particular framework, model provider or vendor. We care that you choose tools based on security, reliability, cost and business need.



Nice to have:



• A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI, Data Science or a related field, or equivalent professional experience

• Experience with multi-client or multi-tenant platforms

• Experience building reusable AI products or platform capabilities

• Experience with knowledge architecture, semantic systems or advanced retrieval

• Experience in a growing company where systems and standards are still taking shape



How you work:



• You think in systems and enjoy rolling up your sleeves to solve problems.

• You're open about your assumptions and blind spots, and you make uncertainty visible.

• You're comfortable making progress with incomplete information.

• You explain technical ideas clearly to both engineers and non-technical colleagues.

• You take security, evidence, quality and human accountability seriously.

• You challenge assumptions constructively, including knowing when AI isn't the right answer.

• You care about outcomes, not just activity.

• You build systems others can use without needing you in the loop.



What success looks like:



• A secure, reusable AI architecture is in place and well understood.

• AI agents do approved work reliably, within clear permissions.

• Everyone knows what AI handles, what people review and when to escalate.

• Teams produce more useful work with less repetition and rework.

• AI costs, risks and performance are visible and under control.

• Developers deliver AI features faster using the patterns you set.

• Our AI capabilities deliver measurable benefits for the business and our clients.



How to apply

Send your CV and a short note about an AI system you built and the results it delivered.

title: Part-Time Sales Appointment Setter – Warm Leads

title: SOCIAL MEDIA · PINTEREST MARKETING
description:
Part-Time Pinterest & Social Media Engagement VA for a Luxury Mahjong Brand

The Tile Edit · Part-time, 20 hrs/week · $400–$450 USD/month, depending on experience · Some overlap with US Central hours



ABOUT US

The Tile Edit makes mahjong sets you'd actually want on your coffee table. We're a woman-founded brand from Texas, we sell in limited drops, and we move fast, with new sets launching every couple of months. Our motto is "welcome to the table": we're all about bringing women together around the game, so our online presence should feel warm, confident, a little cheeky, and never spammy. You'll work directly with our two co-founders. This is a long-term role with room to grow.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Pinterest (the big one): research keywords, build and organize boards, write keyword-optimized pin titles and descriptions, prepare pins in Canva from our photos and blog posts, schedule them consistently, and track what drives traffic to our site

• Instagram (@_thetileedit) and TikTok (@the.tile.edit) engagement: find the right accounts (mahjong players, hosts, design-loving women, home and lifestyle creators) and leave genuine, on-brand comments every day

• Send a short weekly report on what you did and what's working

• Later, possibly: answer routine customer emails using our guidance



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• Proven Pinterest growth results (required) — show us accounts you've grown, with numbers

• Clear, natural, witty written English. Comments must sound like a real person, not a bot

• Experience with luxury lifestyle, home, or e-commerce brands is a big plus

• Comfortable with Canva, Pinterest Trends, and AI tools

• Reliable, organized, and able to make good calls on your own

• Your own computer, reliable internet, and backup internet or power

• At least a couple of hours of overlap with US Central business hours



THIS JOB IS NOT

• A general admin role

• Follow-for-follow, bots, or automated engagement

• A fit for agencies/teams or someone looking for a short side gig



HOW TO APPLY

1. Share links to 1–3 Pinterest accounts you've managed and the results (monthly views, outbound clicks, or follower growth).

2. Visit our Instagram @_thetileedit and write 3 comments you'd leave on 3 different posts from accounts our customers might follow. Include the post links.

3. Tell us your hourly or monthly rate.



Start your application with the words "Welcome to the table" so we know you read the whole post. Applications that skip these steps won't be read.
